introduction:
Introduction About KERENDIA 20MG TABLET

KERENDIA 20MG TABLET contains Finerenone which belongs to a group of medicines called non-steroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist. It is indicated in the management of chronic kidney disease (stage 3 and 4 with abnormal presence of albumin (a type of protein) in the urine) associated with type 2 diabetes in adults.

Finerenone works by blocking the action of certain hormones within the body that can damage your kidneys and heart. During management with KERENDIA 20MG TABLET, your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions and blood potassium levels to analyse the safety and efficacy of the management.

Take KERENDIA 20MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It can be taken with or without meals.

Do not eat grapefruit or drink grapefruit juice as long as you take KERENDIA 20MG TABLET, as it could lead to unpleasant side effects. Before taking KERENDIA 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have high blood potassium levels. Do not take KERENDIA 20MG TABLET if you are allergic to finerenone or have Addison’s disease.

KERENDIA 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless your doctor states it is clearly necessary. Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while taking this medicine. Do not take KERENDIA 20MG TABLET during breastfeeding as it may pass through the breast milk and harm the nursing infant.

Avoid concomitant use of KERENDIA 20MG TABLET with antibacterial, antifungal and antiviral agents, potassium supplements, antidepressants and blood pressure lowering agents as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking KERENDIA 20MG TABLET are high blood potassium, sodium and uric acid levels and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

mechanismOfAction:
How KERENDIA 20MG TABLET Works

Finerenone works by blocking the effects of a hormone called aldosterone, which is involved in regulating salt and water balance in the body. Aldosterone tends to cause the retention of salt and water, leading to increased blood pressure and stress on the kidneys.

By inhibiting the action of aldosterone, finerenone helps to reduce the retention of salt and water, ultimately lowering blood pressure and alleviating the strain on the kidneys. This can be beneficial in slowing down the progression of kidney damage in people with diabetes and chronic kidney disease.
usageDetails:
How to use KERENDIA 20MG TABLET

Take KERENDIA 20MG TABLET under careful medical supervision. It can be taken with or without food. It is usually recommended as one dose per day. However, the dose frequency may vary depending on your age and health condition.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Strictly follow the dosing schedule as advised by your physician to get better results.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking KERENDIA 20MG TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Antifungal agents (such as itraconazole or ketoconazole)
Anti-HIV agents (such as ritonavir, nelfinavir, or cobicistat)
Antibacterial agents (such as clarithromycin, telithromycin)
Diuretics (such as amiloride or triamterene)
Other medicines similar to finrenone (such as eplerenone, esaxerenone, spironolactone, or canrenone)
Trimethoprim, or a combination of trimethoprim + sulfamethoxazole (used for bacterial infections)
Potassium supplements
Erythromycin (an antibacterial agent)
Verapamil (cardiac drugs)
Rifampicin (used for TB)
Antiepiletics (such as carbamazepine, phenytoin, or phenobarbital)
Antidepressants (such as St. John´s Wort, fluvoxamine and nefazodone)
Blood pressure lowering agents (such as atenolol, amlodipine, enalapril, telmisartan, Olmesartan)

B. Drug-Food Interactions:

Do not eat grapefruit or drink grapefruit juice as long as you take KERENDIA 20MG TABLET, as it could lead to unpleasant side effects caused due to overdose of finerenone.

Introduction About RENOLOG TABLET

Renolog Tablet is a nutritional supplement enriched with Alpha Ketoanalogue. It is used as a part of dietary support for individuals aiming to maintain kidney health, particularly in cases of chronic kidney conditions. When taken in combination with a low-protein diet, it provides targeted nutritional assistance to help support kidney function and aids in the management of metabolic waste build-up, including urea, in the body. This formulation is often included in nutritional plans recommended by healthcare professionals for improved metabolic balance.

Renolog Tablet should be taken orally, with or without food, exactly as directed by your doctor. For best results, it is often recommended to be used alongside a low-protein diet, ensuring you meet your daily calorie requirements during the course. Your doctor may advise periodic monitoring of serum calcium levels to ensure safe and effective use. Always follow the prescribed dose and duration without altering your regimen on your own.

The most common side effects of this medicine include increased calcium levels (hypercalcemia), nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain. Before using Renolog Tablet, inform your doctor about any other medicines you are taking for existing health conditions. Do not use this supplement if you are allergic to any of its components or if you have elevated calcium levels (hypercalcemia). Your doctor may recommend regular calcium level checks during the course of use to ensure safe consumption.

Avoid taking Renolog Tablet together with calcium-based supplements or certain antibiotics such as tetracyclines or quinolones, unless advised by your doctor, as these may affect absorption. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, or have liver-related health issues, consult your doctor before use. Refrain from driving or operating machinery until you know how this supplement affects your alertness.

How RENOLOG TABLET Works

Renolog Tablet is formulated with essential amino acids in the form of Alpha Ketoanalogue. This nutritional supplement helps lower blood levels of urea and other nitrogenous waste products by promoting nitrogen recycling. It is ideal for individuals following a low or very low protein diet, supporting metabolic balance, and helping maintain kidney wellness.

How Renolog Tablet Works in the Body:

After ingestion, the alpha ketoanalogues in Renolog are converted into essential amino acids by utilizing nitrogen from non-essential amino acids. This process reduces the nitrogen load on the kidneys, thereby helping to preserve remaining kidney function without increasing metabolic waste.

Renolog Tablet: Mechanism of Action Explained:

Renolog functions by following metabolic pathways similar to amino acids, supporting protein metabolism while minimizing the accumulation of toxic metabolites like urea. This mechanism helps reduce kidney strain in chronic kidney conditions.

Alpha Ketoanalogue – The Science Behind Renolog:

Alpha ketoanalogues are precursors to essential amino acids that do not contribute to nitrogenous waste. Their supplementation with Renolog helps maintain amino acid balance and metabolic health in patients with impaired kidney function.

Benefits of Nitrogen Recycling with Renolog Tablet:

Renolog facilitates nitrogen recycling by converting ketoanalogues into amino acids, reducing the accumulation of nitrogenous waste. This supports metabolic stability and helps delay progression of kidney impairment.

Role of Renolog in Protein Metabolism and Kidney Support:

By improving protein metabolism through Ketoanalogue supplementation, Renolog supports nutritional status and reduces metabolic complications associated with kidney dysfunction.

Why Urea Reduction Matters in Renolog Supplementation:

Elevated urea is a common metabolic waste in kidney disease. Renolog helps decrease blood urea levels, thereby alleviating the toxic burden on kidneys and helping maintain overall renal health.

Understanding Catabolic Pathway Modulation by Renolog Tablet:

Renolog modulates catabolic pathways by supplying essential protein building blocks without increasing nitrogen intake, enabling safer metabolic processing, and supporting the kidneys in chronic disease management.

02.How Renolog Tablet Supports Kidney Function in Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) and Nutritional Management

Renolog Tablet contains Alpha Ketoanalogues, which are nitrogen-free precursors of essential amino acids. This unique composition plays a key role in supporting kidney health, especially for individuals with chronic kidney disease (CKD), as follows:

Nitrogen Recycling and Reduced Nitrogenous Waste:
Alpha Ketoanalogues in Renolog utilize nitrogen from non-essential amino acids in the body to form essential amino acids without adding to the nitrogenous waste load. This process lowers the production and blood levels of urea and other toxic nitrogenous waste products, which tend to accumulate in CKD due to impaired kidney filtration. By reducing this toxic burden, Renolog helps ease the workload on damaged kidneys and preserves residual kidney function.
Supports Protein Metabolism with Low-Protein Diets:
Renolog is designed to be used alongside a low or very low protein diet, a common nutritional strategy in CKD management to limit nitrogen waste. The ketoanalogues supply the body with essential amino acids, helping maintain proper nutrition and metabolic balance without the need for high dietary protein, which would otherwise increase urea levels. This supplementation helps reduce malnutrition and muscle wasting often seen in CKD patients.
Slows Progression of CKD:
By minimizing the accumulation of toxic metabolites and supporting metabolic balance, Renolog contributes to slowing the progression of CKD. It reduces kidney strain by lowering the need for excessive nitrogen filtration and helps delay the onset of end-stage renal disease and the need for dialysis.
Mechanism of Action Summary:
After ingestion, the alpha ketoanalogues are converted into essential amino acids through the transfer of amino groups from non-essential amino acids. This transamination process does not generate additional nitrogenous waste, unlike normal amino acid metabolism. The intake of ketoanalogues therefore supports protein synthesis and metabolic needs without worsening nitrogenous burden or uremia.
Additional Benefits:
Regular monitoring, especially of serum calcium levels, is advised during Renolog therapy because the tablet contains calcium salts as carriers of the ketoanalogues. Taking it with food and avoiding certain antibiotic or calcium supplements ensures optimal absorption and efficacy.

Conclusion:
Renolog Tablet is a nutritional supplement that aids kidney function in CKD by providing essential amino acid precursors without increasing nitrogenous waste, supporting low-protein diets, improving protein metabolism, and helping to slow kidney disease progression. Its action is grounded in the science of nitrogen recycling and metabolic pathway modulation to reduce uremic toxins and preserve residual renal function.

introduction:
Introduction About KERENDIA 10 TABLET

Kerendia 10mg Tablet is a prescription medicine primarily used for adults with chronic kidney disease (CKD) associated with type 2 diabetes mellitus. It is formulated to protect the kidneys and heart by blocking the harmful effects of the hormone aldosterone, which can cause inflammation and scarring in kidney tissues. This medicine is particularly suitable for patients who are at risk of worsening kidney function or cardiovascular complications due to diabetic kidney disease.

It belongs to a class of drugs called non-steroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists. By inhibiting aldosterone activity, it helps reduce kidney inflammation, slow CKD progression, and provide cardiovascular protection. It is ideal for adult patients with type 2 diabetes and CKD who require additional kidney and heart protection despite standard therapy, such as ACE inhibitors or ARBs. Your doctor will evaluate kidney function, potassium levels, and overall health before prescribing this medicine.

Kerendia 10mg Tablet is usually taken once daily, with or without food. Swallow the tablet whole with water and try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent medicine levels in your body. Regular follow-ups and blood tests are important to monitor kidney function and potassium levels. Patients should avoid sudden discontinuation, as consistent therapy is essential for optimal kidney and heart protection.

Kerendia may increase potassium levels or lower blood pressure in some patients. Common side effects include dizziness, fatigue, or mild hyperkalaemia, while rare but serious reactions include severe high potassium or allergic responses. It is not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding, and alcohol intake should be limited. Patients should also avoid potassium-based salt substitutes unless advised by their doctor. Regular monitoring, adherence to dosage, and consultation with healthcare providers are crucial to ensure safe and effective use.

Kerendia 10mg Tablet Mechanism of Action

Kerendia 10mg Tablet works through its active ingredient, Finerenone, a non-steroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist (MRA). In type 2 diabetes with chronic kidney disease, overactivation of mineralocorticoid receptors leads to inflammation and scarring in the kidneys and heart. By blocking these receptors, Kerendia reduces fluid buildup, oxidative stress, and tissue damage. This helps support kidney filtration capacity and reduces further strain on cardiovascular health. Its selective action makes it effective in protecting kidney and heart function while lowering long-term risks.

Kerendia 10mg Tablet is not known to impair driving or the use of heavy machines. However, if you experience dizziness, tiredness, or any unusual effects, avoid such activities until you feel well.

Kerendia 10mg Tablet should be taken carefully in people with severely reduced kidney function or kidney failure. Your doctor may recommend additional monitoring, so always seek medical advice before use.
Patients with moderate to severe liver problems should take Kerendia 10mg Tablet only under close medical supervision. Inform your doctor about your liver health before starting this medicine.

Do not take Kerendia 10mg Tablet if you are allergic to Kerendia 10mg tablet or any of its ingredients. Inform your doctor immediately if you have had previous allergic reactions to similar medicines.
Kerendia 10mg Tablet should be used carefully in people with heart failure or other heart-related issues. Discuss your heart condition with your doctor before starting this medicine.
The safety and effectiveness of Kerendia 10mg Tablet in children and adolescents below 18 years has not been established. It is not recommended unless specifically advised by a doctor.
Elderly patients may be more sensitive to the effects of Kerendia 10mg Tablet. Therefore, it should be used cautiously and only under a doctor’s supervision.

introduction:
Introduction About NATRISE 15MG TABLET

NATRISE 15MG TABLET contains Tolvaptan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasopressin antagonists. It is used to manage low serum sodium levels in adults who have a "syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion" (SIADH), a condition in which the kidneys retain too much water.

The symptoms of SIADH may include nausea, vomiting, headache, confusion, weakness, and feeling sick; muscle weakness, irritability, mental confusion, and tremors (involuntary shaking or movements affecting hands, legs, face, head, or vocal cords).

NATRISE 15MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having problems with kidney function. NATRISE 15MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes, heart disease, liver problems, and a kidney disease called autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD).

If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking NATRISE 15MG TABLET. NATRISE 15MG TABLET should not be used in children or adolescents under the age of 18. The most common side effects of taking NATRISE 15MG TABLET are thirst, dehydration, nausea, headache, and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking NATRISE 15MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Ketoconazole (a medicine used against fungal infections)
Macrolide antibiotics such as erythromycin, azithromycin, and clarithromycin (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Diltiazem (a medicine used in the management of high blood pressure and chest pain)
Medicines that increase the salt in your blood or which contain large amounts of salt (Ex. Sodium bicarbonate, sodium chloride, diuretics like furosemide, and bumetanide)
Barbiturates like phenobarbital, and pentobarbital (medicines used to manage epilepsy/seizures and some sleep disorders)
Rifampicin (a medicine used against tuberculosis)
Digoxin (medicine used in the management of irregular heartbeat and heart failure)

B. Drug–Food interactions:

Do not eat grapefruit or drink grapefruit juice while you are taking this medicine as it can increase the risk of side effects of this medicine. Consult your doctor before taking NATRISE 15MG TABLET.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of NATRISE 15MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are a rise in serum sodium concentration, polyuria, thirst, and dehydration/hypovolemia (profuse and prolonged aquaresis).

introduction:
Introduction About REVLAMER 400MG TABLET

REVLAMER 400MG TABLET contains Sevelamer, which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphate Binding Agents. It is used to control the serum phosphorous levels in patients with long-term kidney disease who are on dialysis. Renal failure is the most common cause of high phosphorous levels, as there is reduced filtration of inorganic phosphate, increasing its serum levels.

During management, your doctor might ask you to take certain tests to avoid any untoward side effects. Follow the diet as advised by your doctor.

REVLAMER 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with low levels of phosphorus in the blood or bowel obstruction. REVLAMER 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have trouble swallowing, motility problems in the stomach and bowel, and in those who have undergone major bowel surgery.

REVLAMER 400MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if your doctor finds it clearly necessary. It is unknown whether REVLAMER 400MG TABLET is excreted in breast milk and may affect your baby, so consult your doctor before taking it during breastfeeding.  REVLAMER 400MG TABLET is not intended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking REVLAMER 400MG TABLET are constipation, vomiting, upper abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, indigestion, flatulence (gas), etc. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.

name: Ketoadd Tablet 20'S
introduction:
Introduction About KETOADD TABLET

Ketoadd Tablet is used to manage chronic kidney disease. Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a long-term illness where the kidneys do not function properly. High blood pressure, diabetes, high cholesterol, kidney infections, renal inflammation, recurring kidney stones, an enlarged prostate, and long-term, regular use of certain medicines such as lithium and non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs are the common causes. 

Ketoadd Tablet contains Alpha Ketoanalogue, Histidine, Lysine, Threonine, Tryptophan, Tyrosine, Nitrogen, and Calcium. Ketoadd Tablet works by preventing the unnecessary increase in urea levels in the blood and improving the metabolism of proteins. Thereby improving renal function. 

You are advised to take Ketoadd Tablet for as long as your doctor has prescribed it for you, depending on your medical condition. Certain common side effects include nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, and abdominal pain.  However, if you are experiencing these adverse effects regularly, you should consult your doctor.

If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, allergic to any ingredients you should seek medical advice before using Ketoadd Tablet. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking Ketoadd Tablet to avoid undesirable side effects. Keep your doctor updated about your health condition and medications to rule out any negative effects.

mechanismOfAction:
How KETOADD TABLET Works
1. Converts to Essential Amino Acids
The keto analogues in Ketoadd are structurally similar to essential amino acids but lack nitrogen.
Once inside the body, they undergo transamination, converting into full amino acids by taking up nitrogen from other sources.
2. Helps Reduce Nitrogen Load
This process allows the body to reuse existing nitrogen, helping avoid excess formation of nitrogenous waste (like urea).
This is especially useful when kidney function is compromised, and waste excretion is limited.
3. Supports Muscle and Metabolic Health
By contributing to protein synthesis without increasing the nitrogen burden, it helps maintain nutritional balance and supports muscle preservation during protein-restricted diets.
4. Complements Low-Protein Diet
Ketoadd is not a protein substitute but works in combination with a low-protein renal diet to help fulfill amino acid requirements without straining kidney function.

More Information
Did You Know?
A low-protein diet may help manage nitrogen load in individuals with long-term kidney challenges—and ketoanalogues like those in Ketoadd are often integrated into such nutrition plans.
Ketoanalogues are typically advised during main meals to align with natural amino acid metabolism and support protein balance in the body.
Ketoadd tablets contain nitrogen-free amino acid analogues, meaning they do not add extra nitrogen to the system—this is why they are often included in dietary routines where nitrogen restriction is a goal.
Consistency matters: These tablets are generally more effective when taken regularly as part of a structured dietary approach rather than occasional use.
These products do not replace protein, but complement a carefully reduced-protein intake that is typically monitored by a dietician or nephrologist.
Electrolyte balance is key: Patients on renal diets are often advised to monitor not just protein but also potassium, sodium, and phosphorus intake, alongside using supplements like ketoanalogues.

introduction:
Introduction About LYVELSA 20MG TABLET

LYVELSA 20MG TABLET contains Finerenone which belongs to a group of medicines called non-steroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist. It is indicated in the management of chronic kidney disease (stage 3 and 4 with abnormal presence of albumin (a type of protein) in the urine) associated with type 2 diabetes in adults.

Finerenone works by blocking the action of certain hormones within the body that can damage your kidneys and heart. During management with LYVELSA 20MG TABLET, your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions and blood potassium levels to analyse the safety and efficacy of the management.

Take LYVELSA 20MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It can be taken with or without meals.

Do not eat grapefruit or drink grapefruit juice as long as you take LYVELSA 20MG TABLET, as it could lead to unpleasant side effects. Before taking LYVELSA 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have high blood potassium levels. Do not take LYVELSA 20MG TABLET if you are allergic to finerenone or have Addison’s disease.

LYVELSA 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless your doctor states it is clearly necessary. Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while taking this medicine. Do not take LYVELSA 20MG TABLET during breastfeeding as it may pass through the breast milk and harm the nursing infant.

Avoid concomitant use of LYVELSA 20MG TABLET with antibacterial, antifungal and antiviral agents, potassium supplements, antidepressants and blood pressure lowering agents as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking LYVELSA 20MG TABLET are high blood potassium, sodium and uric acid levels and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

mechanismOfAction:
How LYVELSA 20MG TABLET Works

Finerenone works by blocking the effects of a hormone called aldosterone, which is involved in regulating salt and water balance in the body. Aldosterone tends to cause the retention of salt and water, leading to increased blood pressure and stress on the kidneys.

By inhibiting the action of aldosterone, finerenone helps to reduce the retention of salt and water, ultimately lowering blood pressure and alleviating the strain on the kidneys. This can be beneficial in slowing down the progression of kidney damage in people with diabetes and chronic kidney disease.
usageDetails:
How to use LYVELSA 20MG TABLET

Take LYVELSA 20MG TABLET under careful medical supervision. It can be taken with or without food. It is usually recommended as one dose per day. However, the dose frequency may vary depending on your age and health condition.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Strictly follow the dosing schedule as advised by your physician to get better results.

name: K Bind Powder 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About K BIND POWDER

K BIND POWDER contains Calcium Polystyrene Sulphonate which belongs to the group of medicines called Ion Exchange Resins. It is used to manage increased potassium levels in blood (hyperkalemia) due to acute and chronic renal failure that occurs after certain conditions. K BIND POWDER is also used in patients with hyperkalemia associated with anuria, severe oliguria (condition marked by low urine output) and in patients requiring dialysis. Hyperkalemia is a condition of abnormally raised levels of potassium in the blood, generally characterized by symptoms such as abdominal pain, diarrhoea, chest pain, irregular heartbeat, muscle weakness, numbness, nausea, and vomiting.

Avoid taking K BIND POWDER with orange juice or other fruit juices that are known to raise the blood potassium levels. It is not recommended for use if you are allergic to calcium polystyrene sulfonate and in patients with other conditions such as bowel obstruction or blocked intestine, thyroid problems and high blood calcium levels. K BIND POWDER should be used with caution if you have breathing or chest problems, kidney or heart problems.

K BIND POWDER should be used with caution during pregnancy and breastfeeding. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking. The common side effects associated with the use of K BIND POWDER are tiredness, confusion, muscle weakness, muscle cramps, altered heart rate, nausea and vomiting. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Hyperkalemia due to acute and chronic renal failure
Hyperkalemia (associated with anuria, severe oliguria and in patients requiring dialysis)
usesDetails:
Uses Of K BIND POWDER

It is used to manage:

Hyperkalemia due to acute and chronic renal failure
Hyperkalemia (associated with anuria, severe oliguria and in patients requiring dialysis)
mechanismOfAction:
How K BIND POWDER Works

K BIND POWDER works by releasing calcium ions in the stomach which binds to hydrogen ions and it gets exchanged with free potassium ions in the large intestine, that gets eliminated with the faeces along with the excess potassium ions thereby resulting in reduced potassium levels in the body.

Take K BIND POWDER as advised by your physician. Avoid using orange juice or other fruit juices. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

K BIND POWDER should be used with caution in patients with breathing, lung or chest problems. Consult your doctor before taking K BIND POWDER.
K BIND POWDER should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Consult your doctor before taking K BIND POWDER.

K BIND POWDER should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking K BIND POWDER.

Others

K BIND POWDER is not recommended for use if you have:

Low levels of potassium in the blood
Conditions associated with high blood calcium levels such as hyperparathyroidism (thyroid disease), or multiple myeloma, sarcoidosis or metastatic carcinoma
Obstructive bowel disease

Before taking K BIND POWDER, inform your doctor if you:

Have history of intestinal disease or surgery
Are under immunosuppressant therapy
Have severe burns
Have constipation
Have gastroparesis (delayed gastric emptying)
Have low blood volume due to dehydration or bleeding.
Have signs of electrolyte imbalance (condition marked by loss of large amount of body fluids)

introduction:
Introduction About NEFROZON TABLET

NEFROZON TABLET is a combination of N-Acetylcysteine and Taurine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Renoprotectives and Amino acids. It is used to manage diabetic kidney disease, paracetamol poisoning, and radiocontrast induced kidney damage. 

It protects the kidneys from damage and reduces the risk of kidney failure. Diabetic kidney disease is caused by diabetes or an increase in blood sugar, which leads to damage to the kidney.

Before taking NEFROZON TABLET, inform your doctor if you have lung or kidney problems, atopy (problem with your immune system that makes you more likely to develop allergic diseases), acute flushing, or erythema.

NEFROZON TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. The most common side effects of taking NEFROZON TABLET are nausea, vomiting, flushing, rash, and mouth sores. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How NEFROZON TABLET Works

NEFROZON TABLET works by slowing down the process of damage to the kidney cells and accordingly improving kidney functioning. It also helps in managing the disintegration of some microalbuminuria in diabetic kidney infections. In Paracetamol poisoning it manages the deterioration of microalbuminuria and enhances the non-toxic sulfate conjugation of paracetamol.

name: Betheran 25mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About BETHERAN 25MG TABLET

BETHERAN 25MG TABLET is used in the management of urinary retention (inability to empty the bladder) following an operation or after giving birth or other health problems (such as brain, spinal, or nerve problems) and is also used to manage reflux esophagitis (inflammation of the esophagus due to backflow of stomach contents into the esophagus).

BETHERAN 25MG TABLET contains bethanechol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Cholinergic agents. It works by making the contraction of urinary bladder muscles sufficiently strong to initiate urination and empty the bladder. It also stimulates motility, increases the tone of the stomach, and often restores impaired rhythmic peristalsis (wave-like muscle contractions that move food through the digestive tract).

BETHERAN 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with gut or heart problems, asthma, fits, parkinsonism, or if you have had recent surgery on your stomach. BETHERAN 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients taking certain medicines for heart problems, as a critical fall in blood pressure may occur.

BETHERAN 25MG TABLET should be used with caution by pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. It is not recommended for use in elderly patients (above 70 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking BETHERAN 25MG TABLET are diarrhea, skin flushing, increased salivation and sweating, decreased body temperature (hypothermia), etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About TOLVAT 15MG TABLET

TOLVAT 15MG TABLET contains Tolvaptan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasopressin antagonists. It is used to manage low serum sodium levels in adults who have a "syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion" (SIADH), a condition in which the kidneys retain too much water.

The symptoms of SIADH may include nausea, vomiting, headache, confusion, weakness, and feeling sick; muscle weakness, irritability, mental confusion, and tremors (involuntary shaking or movements affecting hands, legs, face, head, or vocal cords).

TOLVAT 15MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having problems with kidney function. TOLVAT 15MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes, heart disease, liver problems, and a kidney disease called autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD).

If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking TOLVAT 15MG TABLET. TOLVAT 15MG TABLET should not be used in children or adolescents under the age of 18. The most common side effects of taking TOLVAT 15MG TABLET are thirst, dehydration, nausea, headache, and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About HYPONAT O 15MG TABLET

HYPONAT O 15MG TABLET contains Tolvaptan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasopressin antagonists. It is used to manage low serum sodium levels in adults who have a "syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion" (SIADH), a condition in which the kidneys retain too much water.

The symptoms of SIADH may include nausea, vomiting, headache, confusion, weakness, and feeling sick; muscle weakness, irritability, mental confusion, and tremors (involuntary shaking or movements affecting hands, legs, face, head, or vocal cords).

HYPONAT O 15MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having problems with kidney function. HYPONAT O 15MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes, heart disease, liver problems, and a kidney disease called autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD).

If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking HYPONAT O 15MG TABLET. HYPONAT O 15MG TABLET should not be used in children or adolescents under the age of 18. The most common side effects of taking HYPONAT O 15MG TABLET are thirst, dehydration, nausea, headache, and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

HYPONAT O 15MG TABLET works by suppressing vasopressin (a hormone that helps manage the loss of water from the body by reducing urine output) leading to increased urine production and a raise in sodium concentration in blood.

name: K Cit Oral Solution 450ml
introduction:
Introduction About K CIT ORAL SOLUTION

K Cit Oral Solution is an alkalinizing agent use to manage conditions where long-term maintenance of an alkaline urine is desired such as in patients with uric acid and cystine calculi of the urinary tract, especially when the administration of sodium salts is unwanted or prohibited. Additionally, as urates tend to crystallize out of an acid urine, it is a useful adjuvant when given along with uricosuric medicines in gout therapy. It is also useful in managing the acidosis caused by some renal tubular diseases. It contains Potassium Citrate and Citric Acid as an active ingredient which is used to alkalize urine.

Potassium citrate and Citric acid acts as a systemic alkalizer which helps to make your urine less acidic. It also used to manage acidosis or manage kidney stones or gout in affected individuals.

Take K Cit Oral Solution as advised by the physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will fix the correct dose and duration for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MIRBEG 25MG TABLET

MIRBEG 25MG TABLET contains Mirabegron which belongs to the group of medicines called Bladder muscle relaxants. MIRBEG 25MG TABLET is used in the management of managing the symptoms of overactive bladder (OAB) in adults such as an uncontrollable, sudden urge to urinate (urgency), feeling to pass urine many times during the day and night (increased urinary frequency) and the experience of unintentional loss of urine (urgency incontinence).

Your doctor will check the blood pressure while taking MIRBEG 25MG TABLET in patients with a history of high blood pressure.

MIRBEG 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having uncontrolled high blood pressure (hypertension) and patients who are allergic to mirabegron.

MIRBEG 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver and kidney problems. MIRBEG 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and need to be used with caution among breastfeeding women.

MIRBEG 25MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking MIRBEG 25MG TABLET are increased heart rate (tachycardia), infection of the body parts that carry urine (urinary tract infections), nausea, constipation, headache and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if symptoms get worsen or persists for a longer duration.
uses: Used to manage OAB (overactive bladder) with symptoms of urge urinary incontinence, urgency and urinary frequency
usesDetails:
Uses Of MIRBEG 25MG TABLET
Used to manage OAB (overactive bladder) with symptoms of urge urinary incontinence, urgency and urinary frequency
mechanismOfAction:
How MIRBEG 25MG TABLET Works

MIRBEG 25MG TABLET works by relaxing the muscles around your bladder during the storage phase of the urinary bladder fill-void cycle, which increases the bladder's capacity to hold more urine, thereby reducing the feelings of urgency and the need to urinate frequently.

Take MIRBEG 25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow MIRBEG 25MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About PHOSCUT 400MG TABLET

PHOSCUT 400MG TABLET contains Sevelamer, which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphate Binding Agents. It is used to control the serum phosphorous levels in patients with long-term kidney disease who are on dialysis. Renal failure is the most common cause of high phosphorous levels, as there is reduced filtration of inorganic phosphate, increasing its serum levels.

During management, your doctor might ask you to take certain tests to avoid any untoward side effects. Follow the diet as advised by your doctor.

PHOSCUT 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with low levels of phosphorus in the blood or bowel obstruction. PHOSCUT 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have trouble swallowing, motility problems in the stomach and bowel, and in those who have undergone major bowel surgery.

PHOSCUT 400MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if your doctor finds it clearly necessary. It is unknown whether PHOSCUT 400MG TABLET is excreted in breast milk and may affect your baby, so consult your doctor before taking it during breastfeeding.  PHOSCUT 400MG TABLET is not intended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking PHOSCUT 400MG TABLET are constipation, vomiting, upper abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, indigestion, flatulence (gas), etc. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.

name: UROTONE DS Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About UROTONE DS TABLET

UROTONE DS TABLET is used in the management of urinary retention (inability to empty the bladder) following an operation or after giving birth or other health problems (such as brain, spinal, or nerve problems) and is also used to manage reflux esophagitis (inflammation of the esophagus due to backflow of stomach contents into the esophagus).

UROTONE DS TABLET contains bethanechol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Cholinergic agents. It works by making the contraction of urinary bladder muscles sufficiently strong to initiate urination and empty the bladder. It also stimulates motility, increases the tone of the stomach, and often restores impaired rhythmic peristalsis (wave-like muscle contractions that move food through the digestive tract).

UROTONE DS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with gut or heart problems, asthma, fits, parkinsonism, or if you have had recent surgery on your stomach. UROTONE DS TABLET should be used with caution in patients taking certain medicines for heart problems, as a critical fall in blood pressure may occur.

UROTONE DS TABLET should be used with caution by pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. It is not recommended for use in elderly patients (above 70 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking UROTONE DS TABLET are diarrhea, skin flushing, increased salivation and sweating, decreased body temperature (hypothermia), etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

UROTONE DS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with latent or active bronchial asthma. Consult your doctor before taking UROTONE DS TABLET.

UROTONE DS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have pronounced bradycardia (slow heartbeat) or low blood pressure, coronary artery disease (narrowing or blockage of the coronary arteries, usually due to plaque buildup), or who had a heart attack recently. Safety and effectiveness of UROTONE DS TABLET in children have not been established. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
UROTONE DS TABLET is not recommended for use in elderly patients (above 70 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Have blockage of the gut
Have problems passing urine due to a blockage
Had recent surgery on the stomach
Have hypothyroidism
Have a peptic ulcer
Have vasomotor instability (hot flushing)
Have epilepsy (fits)
Have parkinsonism
Have weak strength or integrity of your gastrointestinal or bladder wall
Have mechanical obstruction (partial or complete blockage of the intestine)
Have increased muscular activity of the gastrointestinal tract or urinary bladder that might prove harmful (Ex. following recent urinary bladder surgery, gastrointestinal resection and anastomosis (surgical connection between two structures), or when there is possible digestive tract obstruction) 
Have bladder-neck obstruction
Have spastic gastrointestinal disturbances
Have acute inflammatory lesions of the digestive tract
Have peritonitis (an inflamed membrane lining the abdominal wall)
Have marked vagotonia (too much excitability of the vagus nerve)

Before taking UROTONE DS TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have urinary retention problem
Have bacteriuria (the presence of bacteria in the urine)

name: CITAL SUGAR FREE Liquid 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About CITAL SUGAR FREE LIQUID

Cital Sugar Free Liquid is a urinary alkalizer which is used in the management of gout (joint pain) and certain types of kidney stones (hard deposits which is formed inside the kidneys).

It can also be used to manage metabolic acidosis (accumulation of acid in the body due to kidney disease) caused by kidney disease. It contains disodium hydrogen citrate as active ingredient which helps to make the urine less acidic and helps the kidneys to get rid of uric acid which are responsible for the episodes of gout and kidney stone formation.

Disodium hydrogen citrate is a urinary alkalizer which works by reducing the acidic urine and promotes mild diuresis. Thus, it manages the episodes of gout and formation of kidney stones.

Always take Cital Sugar Free Liquid as directed by the physician. Shake well before use. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Do not take Cital Sugar Free Liquid if you are allergic to any of its components. Inform your doctor if you are using or have recently used any other medicines including prescription, over the counter medications, as well as vitamin or herbal supplements.

name: Minirin 0.2mg Tablet 30'S
introduction:
Introduction About MINIRIN 0.2MG TABLET

MINIRIN 0.2MG TABLET contains Desmopressin which belongs to the group of medicines called Synthetic antidiuretic peptide. It is used to manage cranial diabetes insipidus (occurs when there's not enough AVP in the body to regulate urine production). It also used to manage primary nocturnal enuresis (bed wetting from the age of 5) and nocturia in adults up to 65 years (night-time urine production exceeding bladder capacity).

Desmopressin works by reducing the amount of water that is eliminated in the urine. It enhances the reabsorption of water in the kidneys. Avoid drinking large amounts of water or fluid during this medication that leads to a build-up of water resulting in dilution of the salt in the body and may cause a serious problems or convulsions.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are dehydrated due to vomiting, diarrhea or systemic infections. There is an increased risk of pre-eclampsia during this medication, so inform your doctor if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant. MINIRIN 0.2MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effect of taking MINIRIN 0.2MG TABLET are headache, stomach pain swelling of ankles. Consult your doctor for advice if you experience the above side effects for a long duration.

How MINIRIN 0.2MG TABLET Works

MINIRIN 0.2MG TABLET mimics the action of endogenous anti-diuretic hormone. After administration, desmopressin works by reducing the amount of water that is eliminated in the urine. It enhances the reabsorption of water in the kidneys.
usageDetails:
How to use MINIRIN 0.2MG TABLET

Always take MINIRIN 0.2MG TABLET as directed by your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your condition. Avoid drinking large amounts of water while taking MINIRIN 0.2MG TABLET since it could lead to a build-up of water leading to serious problems or convulsions.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Mouth Dissolving Tablet: It should be placed under the tongue where it dissolves without the need for water.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking MINIRIN 0.2MG TABLET.

Hyponatraemia (serum sodium levels below normal range)

An illness causing fluid and/or salt imbalance (e.g. vomiting, diarrhea, systemic infections, fever or gastroenteritis)
A medical condition that could be made worse by fluid and/or electrolyte disturbance
Cystic fibrosis
Difficulty in passing water

introduction:
Introduction About MIRBEG 50MG TABLET

MIRBEG 50MG TABLET contains Mirabegron which belongs to the group of medicines called Bladder muscle relaxants. MIRBEG 50MG TABLET is used in the management of managing the symptoms of overactive bladder (OAB) in adults such as an uncontrollable, sudden urge to urinate (urgency), feeling to pass urine many times during the day and night (increased urinary frequency) and the experience of unintentional loss of urine (urgency incontinence).

Your doctor will check the blood pressure while taking MIRBEG 50MG TABLET in patients with a history of high blood pressure.

MIRBEG 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having uncontrolled high blood pressure (hypertension) and patients who are allergic to mirabegron.

MIRBEG 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver and kidney problems. MIRBEG 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and need to be used with caution among breastfeeding women.

MIRBEG 50MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking MIRBEG 50MG TABLET are increased heart rate (tachycardia), infection of the body parts that carry urine (urinary tract infections), nausea, constipation, headache and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if symptoms get worsen or persists for a longer duration.
uses: Used to manage OAB (overactive bladder) with symptoms of urge urinary incontinence, urgency and urinary frequency

mechanismOfAction:
How MIRBEG 50MG TABLET Works

MIRBEG 50MG TABLET works by relaxing the muscles around your bladder during the storage phase of the urinary bladder fill-void cycle, which increases the bladder's capacity to hold more urine, thereby reducing the feelings of urgency and the need to urinate frequently.

Take MIRBEG 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow MIRBEG 50MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Allcitra Syrup 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About ALLCITRA SYRUP

ALLCITRA SYRUP contains Disodium Hydrogen Citrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Urinary Alkalizers. It is used to manage the symptoms of urinary tract infections (such as low urine output, painful urination or burning sensation while passing urine) when used in combination with antibiotics.

It works by increasing your blood pH and by making your urine less acidic. Therefore, it helps in managing metabolic acidosis (low pH in blood) and hyperuricemia (high blood uric acid levels) and manage the incidence of gout and/or kidney stones caused due to high blood uric acid levels.

It corrects dehydration by replacing the lost electrolytes in the body. It also helps in managing the symptoms of inflammation in the urinary tract such as pyelitis, cystitis, urethritis and urolithiasis. ALLCITRA SYRUP must be dissolved in water before consumption.

Before taking ALLCITRA SYRUP inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have Addison’s disease, fluid retention in your body parts or lungs, hypertension or heat cramps as a precaution.

Do not take ALLCITRA SYRUP without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ALLCITRA SYRUP are increased urination, diarrhea and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects troubles you.

How ALLCITRA SYRUP Works

ALLCITRA SYRUP is a urinary alkalizer. It works by increasing the pH of the blood and urine. This makes your urine less acidic which helps in managing the urinary symptoms (such as painful urination, low urine output or burning sensation while passing urine) caused due to urinary tract infections or inflammation.

It also replenishes the lost electrolytes in the body and increases urine output which helps in managing dehydration and in flushing out harmful bacteria that causes urinary tract infection.

Take ALLCITRA SYRUP as advised by your physician. Dissolve the required amount of the medicine in water before consumption. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, amount of water to be used for dissolution and duration of therapy based on your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking ALLCITRA SYRUP without consulting your doctor.

Therefore, it should be used in pregnant women only if considered necessary by the physician. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant women with toxaemia (high blood pressure during pregnancy due to infections).
The safety and effectiveness of ALLCITRA SYRUP have not been established in breastfeeding women. Therefore, it should be used in breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician.
ALLCITRA SYRUP is unlikely to affect your ability for driving or handling any heavy tools or machines.

ALLCITRA SYRUP is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems (such as oliguria, azotemia or anuria). It should be used with caution in patients with low urine output. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ALLCITRA SYRUP should be used with caution in patients with acute liver failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ALLCITRA SYRUP if you are allergic to Disodium hydrogen citrate.
ALLCITRA SYRUP should be used with caution in patients with fluid accumulation in the lungs. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

ALLCITRA SYRUP is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems (such as myocardial damage). It should be used with caution in patients with heart failure or hypertension. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ALLCITRA SYRUP should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.
ALLCITRA SYRUP should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

ALLCITRA SYRUP is not recommended for use if you:

Have Addison’s disease (a disease caused due to problems in adrenal gland)
Have acute dehydration or heat cramps

Before taking ALLCITRA SYRUP inform your doctor if you:

Have fluid retention in your body

name: Citralka Liquid 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About CITRALKA LIQUID

Citralka Liquid is used to make urine alkaline in various conditions such pyelitis, urethritis, cystitis and urolithiasis also during management with urinary tract infections with antibiotics and to overcome tendency of acute or chronic metabolic acidosis in acute infections and dehydration. It contains disodium hydrogen citrate as an active ingredient to aid in maintaining physiological alkalinity of blood and urine.

Disodium hydrogen citrate is a urinary alkalinizer which is used to make the urine alkaline and less acidic. It does so by getting metabolized into bicarbonates which results in the increase of pH. Hence, it increases the alkalinity of the urine. Also, it promotes mildly increased urination (diuresis).

Always take Citralka Liquid as advised by the doctor. Recommended dosage for adults is 30 ml (two tablespoonful) 4 times daily and for children 6 to 12 years is 10 or 15 ml (two or three tablespoonful) 3 to 4 times daily. It is to be taken with milk or water, adults may take it without dilution followed by liquid if preferred.

introduction:
Introduction About PHOSCUT 800MG TABLET

PHOSCUT 800MG TABLET contains Sevelamer, which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphate Binding Agents. It is used to control the serum phosphorous levels in patients with long-term kidney disease who are on dialysis. Renal failure is the most common cause of high phosphorous levels, as there is reduced filtration of inorganic phosphate, increasing its serum levels.

During management, your doctor might ask you to take certain tests to avoid any untoward side effects. Follow the diet as advised by your doctor.

PHOSCUT 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with low levels of phosphorus in the blood or bowel obstruction. PHOSCUT 800MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have trouble swallowing, motility problems in the stomach and bowel, and in those who have undergone major bowel surgery.

PHOSCUT 800MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if your doctor finds it clearly necessary. It is unknown whether PHOSCUT 800MG TABLET is excreted in breast milk and may affect your baby, so consult your doctor before taking it during breastfeeding.  PHOSCUT 800MG TABLET is not intended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking PHOSCUT 800MG TABLET are constipation, vomiting, upper abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, indigestion, flatulence (gas), etc. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.

Do not stop taking PHOSCUT 800MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

name: Macpee Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MACPEE TABLET

MACPEE TABLET is used in the management of urinary retention (inability to empty the bladder) following an operation or after giving birth or other health problems (such as brain, spinal, or nerve problems) and is also used to manage reflux esophagitis (inflammation of the esophagus due to backflow of stomach contents into the esophagus).

MACPEE TABLET contains bethanechol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Cholinergic agents. It works by making the contraction of urinary bladder muscles sufficiently strong to initiate urination and empty the bladder. It also stimulates motility, increases the tone of the stomach, and often restores impaired rhythmic peristalsis (wave-like muscle contractions that move food through the digestive tract).

MACPEE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with gut or heart problems, asthma, fits, parkinsonism, or if you have had recent surgery on your stomach. MACPEE TABLET should be used with caution in patients taking certain medicines for heart problems, as a critical fall in blood pressure may occur.

MACPEE TABLET should be used with caution by pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. It is not recommended for use in elderly patients (above 70 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking MACPEE TABLET are diarrhea, skin flushing, increased salivation and sweating, decreased body temperature (hypothermia), etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NATREMIA 15 TABLET

NATREMIA 15 TABLET contains Tolvaptan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasopressin antagonists. It is used to manage low serum sodium levels in adults who have a "syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion" (SIADH), a condition in which the kidneys retain too much water.

The symptoms of SIADH may include nausea, vomiting, headache, confusion, weakness, and feeling sick; muscle weakness, irritability, mental confusion, and tremors (involuntary shaking or movements affecting hands, legs, face, head, or vocal cords).

NATREMIA 15 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having problems with kidney function. NATREMIA 15 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes, heart disease, liver problems, and a kidney disease called autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD).

If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking NATREMIA 15 TABLET. NATREMIA 15 TABLET should not be used in children or adolescents under the age of 18. The most common side effects of taking NATREMIA 15 TABLET are thirst, dehydration, nausea, headache, and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

NATREMIA 15 TABLET works by suppressing vasopressin (a hormone that helps manage the loss of water from the body by reducing urine output) leading to increased urine production and a raise in sodium concentration in blood.

Take NATREMIA 15 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine, do not crush, or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Hypernatremia (a condition which increases the salt in blood)

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of NATREMIA 15 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are a rise in serum sodium concentration, polyuria, thirst, and dehydration/hypovolemia (profuse and prolonged aquaresis).

introduction:
Introduction About CITRO SODA SACHET

CITRO SODA SACHET contains Citric acid, Sodium citrate, Sodium bicarbonate and Tartaric acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Urinary alkalinizing agents and Antacids respectively. It is used in cases of temporary relief from minor gastric upsets, in combination with antibiotics, when the effectiveness of an antibiotic is increased in the presence of alkaline urine and in urinary conditions where alkaline urine will benefit and helps kidneys to get rid of uric acid in blood as well as removes kidney stones due to high uric acid.

This medicine is also used to manage kidney stones, uric acid in blood, urinary tract infections (painful and difficulty in urination). During management with CITRO SODA SACHET, the clinical condition of the patient should be assessed, and laboratory results (such as serum electrolytes, acid-base balance) should be collected periodically especially in patients with kidney diseases. CITRO SODA SACHET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney failure or increased sodium concentration in blood (hypernatremia) along with hexamine mandelate or hexamine Hippurate therapy (management for urinary infection) where acidic nature of urine is needed.

CITRO SODA SACHET should be taken with caution in patients with increased blood pressure, heart failure, decreased or loss of kidney function, swelling in legs (peripheral oedema), pulmonary oedema, high blood pressure during pregnancy (pre-eclampsia). The most common side effects of taking CITRO SODA SACHET are nausea, weakness, vomiting, diarrhoea and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About REVLAMER 800MG TABLET

REVLAMER 800MG TABLET contains Sevelamer, which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphate Binding Agents. It is used to control the serum phosphorous levels in patients with long-term kidney disease who are on dialysis. Renal failure is the most common cause of high phosphorous levels, as there is reduced filtration of inorganic phosphate, increasing its serum levels.

During management, your doctor might ask you to take certain tests to avoid any untoward side effects. Follow the diet as advised by your doctor.

REVLAMER 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with low levels of phosphorus in the blood or bowel obstruction. REVLAMER 800MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have trouble swallowing, motility problems in the stomach and bowel, and in those who have undergone major bowel surgery.

REVLAMER 800MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if your doctor finds it clearly necessary. It is unknown whether REVLAMER 800MG TABLET is excreted in breast milk and may affect your baby, so consult your doctor before taking it during breastfeeding.  REVLAMER 800MG TABLET is not intended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking REVLAMER 800MG TABLET are constipation, vomiting, upper abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, indigestion, flatulence (gas), etc. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.

Do not stop taking REVLAMER 800MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About LUPINAC TABLET

LUPINAC TABLET is a combination of N-Acetylcysteine and Taurine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Renoprotectives and Amino acids. It is used to manage diabetic kidney disease, paracetamol poisoning, and radiocontrast induced kidney damage. 

It protects the kidneys from damage and reduces the risk of kidney failure. Diabetic kidney disease is caused by diabetes or an increase in blood sugar, which leads to damage to the kidney.

Before taking LUPINAC TABLET, inform your doctor if you have lung or kidney problems, atopy (problem with your immune system that makes you more likely to develop allergic diseases), acute flushing, or erythema.

LUPINAC TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. The most common side effects of taking LUPINAC TABLET are nausea, vomiting, flushing, rash, and mouth sores. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

It also helps in managing the disintegration of some microalbuminuria in diabetic kidney infections. In Paracetamol poisoning it manages the deterioration of microalbuminuria and enhances the non-toxic sulfate conjugation of paracetamol.

introduction:
Introduction About ALKAPAC SUGAR FREE CARDAMOM FLAVOUR SYRUP

ALKAPAC SUGAR FREE CARDAMOM FLAVOUR Syrup is a health supplement used to manage the symptoms of urinary tract infection. It contains Cranberry extract, D-Mannose and Potassium Magnesium Citrate as active ingredients.

Both Cranberry and D-Mannose enables the flushing of bacteria from the urinary tract that causes infection. They work by managing the bacteria from sticking to the walls of the bladder and ureters. Potassium Magnesium citrate makes the urine less acidic which therefore reduces irritation or burning sensation while passing urine. Collectively, they help in management of signs associated with urinary tract infection such as painful urination, burning sensation while passing urine, scanty urine, etc.

Take ALKAPAC SUGAR FREE CARDAMOM FLAVOUR Syrup as advised by your physician. Your doctor may advise you to dilute the medicine in a glass of water before consumption. Along with ALKAPAC SUGAR FREE CARDAMOM FLAVOUR Syrup, your doctor may ask you to drink plenty of fluids to help flush out the bacteria quickly, which in turn leads to a fast recovery.

introduction:
Introduction About URIVOID 25MG TABLET

URIVOID 25MG TABLET is used in the management of urinary retention (inability to empty the bladder) following an operation or after giving birth or other health problems (such as brain, spinal, or nerve problems) and is also used to manage reflux esophagitis (inflammation of the esophagus due to backflow of stomach contents into the esophagus).

URIVOID 25MG TABLET contains bethanechol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Cholinergic agents. It works by making the contraction of urinary bladder muscles sufficiently strong to initiate urination and empty the bladder. It also stimulates motility, increases the tone of the stomach, and often restores impaired rhythmic peristalsis (wave-like muscle contractions that move food through the digestive tract).

URIVOID 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with gut or heart problems, asthma, fits, parkinsonism, or if you have had recent surgery on your stomach. URIVOID 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients taking certain medicines for heart problems, as a critical fall in blood pressure may occur.

URIVOID 25MG TABLET should be used with caution by pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. It is not recommended for use in elderly patients (above 70 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking URIVOID 25MG TABLET are diarrhea, skin flushing, increased salivation and sweating, decreased body temperature (hypothermia), etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About KCHEK LEMON FLAVOUR SACHET

KCHEK LEMON FLAVOUR SACHET contains Calcium Polystyrene Sulphonate which belongs to the group of medicines called Ion Exchange Resins. It is used to manage increased potassium levels in blood (hyperkalemia) due to acute and chronic renal failure that occurs after certain conditions. KCHEK LEMON FLAVOUR SACHET is also used in patients with hyperkalemia associated with anuria, severe oliguria (condition marked by low urine output) and in patients requiring dialysis. Hyperkalemia is a condition of abnormally raised levels of potassium in the blood, generally characterized by symptoms such as abdominal pain, diarrhoea, chest pain, irregular heartbeat, muscle weakness, numbness, nausea, and vomiting.

Avoid taking KCHEK LEMON FLAVOUR SACHET with orange juice or other fruit juices that are known to raise the blood potassium levels. It is not recommended for use if you are allergic to calcium polystyrene sulfonate and in patients with other conditions such as bowel obstruction or blocked intestine, thyroid problems and high blood calcium levels. KCHEK LEMON FLAVOUR SACHET should be used with caution if you have breathing or chest problems, kidney or heart problems.

KCHEK LEMON FLAVOUR SACHET should be used with caution during pregnancy and breastfeeding. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking. The common side effects associated with the use of KCHEK LEMON FLAVOUR SACHET are tiredness, confusion, muscle weakness, muscle cramps, altered heart rate, nausea and vomiting. introduction:
Introduction About DARILONG 7.5MG TABLET

DARILONG 7.5MG TABLET contains Darifenacin which belongs to a group of medicines called Antimuscarinics. DARILONG 7.5MG TABLET is used in adults to manage symptoms of overactive bladder conditions such as a sudden urge to rush to the toilet, needing to go to the toilet frequently and/or not getting to the toilet in time and wetting yourself (urge incontinence).

DARILONG 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Darifenacin. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from urinary retention (inability to empty your bladder), gastric retention, uncontrolled narrow-angle glaucoma (high pressure in the eyes),  that is not being adequately manageed), myasthenia gravis (disease characterized by unusual tiredness and weakness of selective muscles), severe ulcerative colitis/toxic megacolon (inflammatory bowel disease), and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking DARILONG 7.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have autonomic neuropathy (a condition of nerve damage), difficulties while passing urine, severe constipation, digestive motility disorder, obstructive gastrointestinal disorder (any obstruction of the passage of intestinal or gastric contents), mild to moderate liver problems, and/or kidney problems.

DARILONG 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and is advised to be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

DARILONG 7.5MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking DARILONG 7.5MG TABLET are dry mouth, constipation, headache, abdominal pain, indigestion, nausea, and/or dry eyes. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How DARILONG 7.5MG TABLET Works

DARILONG 7.5MG TABLET works by blocking certain receptors (M3 muscarinic acetylcholine receptors, responsible for bladder muscle contractions) which reduces the muscle spasms of the bladder and urinary tract thereby relaxing the bladder muscles that results in the  management of urgent, frequent, or uncontrolled urination.

introduction:
Introduction About K CIT ORAL SOLUTION

K Cit Oral Solution is an alkalinizing agent use to manage conditions where long-term maintenance of an alkaline urine is desired such as in patients with uric acid and cystine calculi of the urinary tract, especially when the administration of sodium salts is unwanted or prohibited. Additionally, as urates tend to crystallize out of an acid urine, it is a useful adjuvant when given along with uricosuric medicines in gout therapy. It is also useful in managing the acidosis caused by some renal tubular diseases. It contains Potassium Citrate and Citric Acid as an active ingredient which is used to alkalize urine.

Potassium citrate and Citric acid acts as a systemic alkalizer which helps to make your urine less acidic. It also used to manage acidosis or manage kidney stones or gout in affected individuals.

Take K Cit Oral Solution as advised by the physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will fix the correct dose and duration for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CITAL SYRUP

Cital Syrup is a urinary alkalizer which is used in the management of gout (joint pain) and certain types of kidney stones (hard deposits which is formed inside the kidneys). It can also be used to inhibit the occurrence of metabolic acidosis (accumulation of acid in the body due to kidney disease) caused by kidney disease. It contains disodium hydrogen citrate as an active ingredient to make the urine less acidic and helps the kidneys to get rid of uric acid which are responsible for the episodes of gout and kidney stone formation.

Disodium hydrogen citrate is a urinary alkalizer which works by reducing the acidic urine and promotes mild diuresis. Thus, it controls the episodes of gout and formation of kidney stones.      

Always take Cital Syrup as advised by the doctor. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Do not take Cital Syrup if you are allergic to its active ingredient. Inform your doctor if you are taking or have recently taken any other medicines including prescription, over the counter medications, as well as vitamin or herbal supplements.

Introduction About POTRATE 10MG TABLET

POTRATE 10MG TABLET contains Potassium citrate which belongs to the group of medicines known as Urinary alkalinizers. It is used in management of renal tubular acidosis (accumulation of acids due to decreased kidney functions) with calcium stones, uric acid lithiasis (uric acid stone formation) with or without calcium stones, hypocitraturic calcium oxalate nephrolithiasis (calcium oxalate stones) of any cause.

POTRATE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with chronic kidney disease, heart disease such as heart failure or severe myocardial damage, uncontrolled diabetes mellitus, acute dehydration, adrenal insufficiency, delayed gastric emptying, extensive tissue breakdown, oesophageal compression, intestinal obstruction or narrowing, peptic ulcer disease, active urinary tract infection. Consult your doctor before taking it.

POTRATE 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart block. Consult your doctor before taking it.

POTRATE 10MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking it. POTRATE 10MG TABLET should be used in breast feeding women only if clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The safety and effectiveness of POTRATE 10MG TABLET in children have not been established. Consult your doctor before taking. Contact your doctor if the symptoms got worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How POTRATE 10MG TABLET Works

POTRATE 10MG TABLET works by increasing urinary PH (alkaline) and raises urinary citrate by stopping its clearance. It also increases the urinary potassium and also reduces urinary calcium levels in some patients. Thus the changes induced by POTRATE 10MG TABLET produces urine that is less prone to formation of stones (calcium oxalate, calcium phosphate and uric acid). POTRATE 10MG TABLET also decreases calcium ion concentration by forming complex and the rise in urinary pH also increases the ionization of uric acid to the more soluble urate ion.

introduction:
Introduction About SEVOM 400 TABLET

SEVOM 400 TABLET contains Sevelamer, which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphate Binding Agents. It is used to control the serum phosphorous levels in patients with long-term kidney disease who are on dialysis. Renal failure is the most common cause of high phosphorous levels, as there is reduced filtration of inorganic phosphate, increasing its serum levels.

During management, your doctor might ask you to take certain tests to avoid any untoward side effects. Follow the diet as advised by your doctor.

SEVOM 400 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with low levels of phosphorus in the blood or bowel obstruction. SEVOM 400 TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have trouble swallowing, motility problems in the stomach and bowel, and in those who have undergone major bowel surgery.

SEVOM 400 TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if your doctor finds it clearly necessary. It is unknown whether SEVOM 400 TABLET is excreted in breast milk and may affect your baby, so consult your doctor before taking it during breastfeeding.  SEVOM 400 TABLET is not intended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking SEVOM 400 TABLET are constipation, vomiting, upper abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, indigestion, flatulence (gas), etc. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.

Take SEVOM 400 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide an appropriate dose and duration of SEVOM 400 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking SEVOM 400 TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About ALKARATE LIQUID

ALKARATE LIQUID contains Disodium Hydrogen Citrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Urinary Alkalizers. It is used to manage the symptoms of urinary tract infections (such as low urine output, painful urination or burning sensation while passing urine) when used in combination with antibiotics.

It works by increasing your blood pH and by making your urine less acidic. Therefore, it helps in managing metabolic acidosis (low pH in blood) and hyperuricemia (high blood uric acid levels) and manage the incidence of gout and/or kidney stones caused due to high blood uric acid levels.

It corrects dehydration by replacing the lost electrolytes in the body. It also helps in managing the symptoms of inflammation in the urinary tract such as pyelitis, cystitis, urethritis and urolithiasis. ALKARATE LIQUID must be dissolved in water before consumption.

Before taking ALKARATE LIQUID inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have Addison’s disease, fluid retention in your body parts or lungs, hypertension or heat cramps as a precaution.

Do not take ALKARATE LIQUID without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ALKARATE LIQUID are increased urination, diarrhea and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects troubles you.

ALKARATE LIQUID is a urinary alkalizer. It works by increasing the pH of the blood and urine. This makes your urine less acidic which helps in managing the urinary symptoms (such as painful urination, low urine output or burning sensation while passing urine) caused due to urinary tract infections or inflammation.

It also replenishes the lost electrolytes in the body and increases urine output which helps in managing dehydration and in flushing out harmful bacteria that causes urinary tract infection.
