introduction:
Introduction About K MAC SUGAR FREE WITH MIXED FRUIT FLAVOUR ORAL SOLUTION

K MAC SUGAR FREE WITH MIXED FRUIT FLAVOUR ORAL SOLUTION is a combination of Potassium citrate and Magnesium citrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Urinary alkalizers and Saline laxatives respectively. It is used in the management of renal tubular acidosis with calcium stones and kidney stones (hypocitraturic calcium oxalate nephrolithiasis and uric acid lithiasis with or without calcium stones).

Renal tubular acidosis is a condition in which the kidneys do not remove acids from the blood into the urine as they usually should. Before taking K MAC SUGAR FREE WITH MIXED FRUIT FLAVOUR ORAL SOLUTION, your doctor might want you to take certain blood tests and ECG to understand your existing condition.

K MAC SUGAR FREE WITH MIXED FRUIT FLAVOUR ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients with hyperkalemia (high potassium levels in the blood), gastrointestinal disease, peptic ulcer disease, urinary tract infection and kidney disease.

K MAC SUGAR FREE WITH MIXED FRUIT FLAVOUR ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is clearly advised by the doctor. Safety and effectiveness of K MAC SUGAR FREE WITH MIXED FRUIT FLAVOUR ORAL SOLUTION in children has not been established yet. The most common side effects of taking K MAC SUGAR FREE WITH MIXED FRUIT FLAVOUR ORAL SOLUTION are abdominal discomfort, nausea, vomiting and diarrhea.

name: Albunil Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ALBUNIL TABLET

Albunil Tablet is a nutritional supplement which is used to save the nephrons (functional unit of the kidney) by reducing the progression of chronic kidney disease associated with diabetes and hypertension (high blood pressure).

It contains acetylcysteine and taurine as the active ingredients that work together to manage microalbuminuria (persistently high albumin levels in urine) and protect kidneys.

The combination of N-Acetylcysteine and Taurine helps to make sure that the individual having diabetes and kidney problem at a single time doesn’t get any further problems that can cause kidney failure. It helps in removing toxic material from the body through urea, protects the individual from free radicals (harmful chemicals) and improves kidney function.

Take one Albunil Tablet daily or as recommended by your doctor. Do not exceed the recommended dosage. Before taking Albunil Tablet, inform your doctor if you have asthma, acute flushing, or erythema (redness). Avoid consumption of alcohol with this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About VAPTAN TABLET

VAPTAN TABLET contains Tolvaptan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasopressin antagonists. It is used to manage low serum sodium levels in adults who have a "syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion" (SIADH), a condition in which the kidneys retain too much water.

The symptoms of SIADH may include nausea, vomiting, headache, confusion, weakness, and feeling sick; muscle weakness, irritability, mental confusion, and tremors (involuntary shaking or movements affecting hands, legs, face, head, or vocal cords).

VAPTAN TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having problems with kidney function. VAPTAN TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes, heart disease, liver problems, and a kidney disease called autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD).

If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking VAPTAN TABLET. VAPTAN TABLET should not be used in children or adolescents under the age of 18. The most common side effects of taking VAPTAN TABLET are thirst, dehydration, nausea, headache, and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.
uses: Manage low serum sodium levels (hyponatremia) in adults who have “syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion” (SIADH)
usesDetails:
Uses Of VAPTAN TABLET
Manage low serum sodium levels (hyponatremia) in adults who have “syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion” (SIADH)
mechanismOfAction:
How VAPTAN TABLET Works

VAPTAN TABLET works by suppressing vasopressin (a hormone that helps manage the loss of water from the body by reducing urine output) leading to increased urine production and a raise in sodium concentration in blood.
usageDetails:
How to use VAPTAN TABLET

Take VAPTAN TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine, do not crush, or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Hypernatremia (a condition which increases the salt in blood)
Any condition which is associated with a very low blood volume
Feeling of not realising when you are thirsty

Diabetes

name: Urofit Uti Sugar Free Suspension 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About UROFIT UTI SUSPENSION

Urofit Uti Sugar Free Suspension is a health supplement used to manage the symptoms of urinary tract infection. It contains Cranberry extract, D-Mannose and Potassium Magnesium Citrate as active ingredients.

Both Cranberry and D-Mannose enables the flushing of bacteria from the urinary tract that causes infection. They work by managing the bacteria from sticking to the walls of the bladder and ureters. Potassium Magnesium citrate makes the urine less acidic which therefore reduces irritation or burning sensation while passing urine. Collectively, they help in management of signs associated with urinary tract infection such as painful urination, burning sensation while passing urine, scanty urine, etc.

Take Urofit Uti Sugar Free Suspension as advised by your physician. Your doctor may advise you to dilute the medicine in a glass of water before consumption. Along with Urofit Uti Sugar Free Suspension, your doctor may ask you to drink plenty of fluids to help flush out the bacteria quickly, which in turn leads to a fast recovery.

introduction:
Introduction About STON 1 DELICIOUS PINEAPPLE FLAVOUR ORAL SOLUTION

STON 1 DELICIOUS PINEAPPLE FLAVOUR ORAL SOLUTION is a combination of Potassium citrate and Magnesium citrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Urinary alkalizers and Saline laxatives respectively. It is used in the management of renal tubular acidosis with calcium stones and kidney stones (hypocitraturic calcium oxalate nephrolithiasis and uric acid lithiasis with or without calcium stones).

Renal tubular acidosis is a condition in which the kidneys do not remove acids from the blood into the urine as they usually should. Before taking STON 1 DELICIOUS PINEAPPLE FLAVOUR ORAL SOLUTION, your doctor might want you to take certain blood tests and ECG to understand your existing condition.

STON 1 DELICIOUS PINEAPPLE FLAVOUR ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients with hyperkalemia (high potassium levels in the blood), gastrointestinal disease, peptic ulcer disease, urinary tract infection and kidney disease.

STON 1 DELICIOUS PINEAPPLE FLAVOUR ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is clearly advised by the doctor. Safety and effectiveness of STON 1 DELICIOUS PINEAPPLE FLAVOUR ORAL SOLUTION in children has not been established yet. The most common side effects of taking STON 1 DELICIOUS PINEAPPLE FLAVOUR ORAL SOLUTION are abdominal discomfort, nausea, vomiting and diarrhea.
uses: Renal tubular acidosis (RTA) with calcium stones
Hypocitraturic calcium oxalate nephrolithiasis
Uric acid lithiasis (with or without calcium stones)

mechanismOfAction:
How STON 1 DELICIOUS PINEAPPLE FLAVOUR ORAL SOLUTION Works

STON 1 DELICIOUS PINEAPPLE FLAVOUR ORAL SOLUTION works by reducing the kidney stone formation. Potassium citrate and magnesium citrate, causes the metabolism of absorbed citrate producing an alkaline load. In addition to raising urinary pH and citrate, this also increases urinary potassium and magnesium. In certain patients, potassium citrate causes a transient reduction in urinary calcium. These changes produce urine that is less helpful to the crystallization of stone-forming salts.

introduction:
Introduction About RENUM SC 400 TABLET

RENUM SC 400 TABLET contains Sevelamer, which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphate Binding Agents. It is used to control the serum phosphorous levels in patients with long-term kidney disease who are on dialysis. Renal failure is the most common cause of high phosphorous levels, as there is reduced filtration of inorganic phosphate, increasing its serum levels.

During management, your doctor might ask you to take certain tests to avoid any untoward side effects. Follow the diet as advised by your doctor.

RENUM SC 400 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with low levels of phosphorus in the blood or bowel obstruction. RENUM SC 400 TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have trouble swallowing, motility problems in the stomach and bowel, and in those who have undergone major bowel surgery.

RENUM SC 400 TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if your doctor finds it clearly necessary. It is unknown whether RENUM SC 400 TABLET is excreted in breast milk and may affect your baby, so consult your doctor before taking it during breastfeeding.  RENUM SC 400 TABLET is not intended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking RENUM SC 400 TABLET are constipation, vomiting, upper abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, indigestion, flatulence (gas), etc. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.
uses: Used to control the serum phosphorous levels in patients with chronic kidney disease who are on dialysis

How RENUM SC 400 TABLET Works

RENUM SC 400 TABLET is a chelating agent that helps in reducing the phosphorus levels in the blood by binding to the phosphate that enters the body with food and managing its absorption.

How to use RENUM SC 400 TABLET

Take RENUM SC 400 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide an appropriate dose and duration of RENUM SC 400 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking RENUM SC 400 TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About ORICITRAL SYRUP

Oricitral Syrup is a systemic alkalizer used to relieve abdominal gas, gout, acidity constipation, discomfort due to urinary tract infections, gastric complications, gastric problems etc. It contains disodium hydrogen citrate as an active ingredient which helps manage the formation of gout and kidney stones.

Disodium Hydrogen Citrate is an acidity regulator and antioxidant that helps in reducing the levels of uric levels in blood through increased urine excretion. It also helps make urine less acidic which helps the kidneys get rid of uric acid and manage the formation of gout and kidney stones.

Always take Oricitral Syrup exactly as advised by your doctor. It is not recommended for patients having high blood pressure, edema (fluid accumulation in the body), low blood calcium levels, kidney dysfunction and increased alkalinity of blood. Before taking, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of ORICITRAL SYRUP

Oricitral Syrup may cause stomach cramps, diuresis, mood swings, vomiting, nausea, tiredness and flatulence in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you experience any such effects while taking it.

name: Dariten OD 7.5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About DARITEN OD 7.5MG TABLET

DARITEN OD 7.5MG TABLET contains Darifenacin which belongs to a group of medicines called Antimuscarinics. DARITEN OD 7.5MG TABLET is used in adults to manage symptoms of overactive bladder conditions such as a sudden urge to rush to the toilet, needing to go to the toilet frequently and/or not getting to the toilet in time and wetting yourself (urge incontinence).

DARITEN OD 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Darifenacin. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from urinary retention (inability to empty your bladder), gastric retention, uncontrolled narrow-angle glaucoma (high pressure in the eyes),  that is not being adequately manageed), myasthenia gravis (disease characterized by unusual tiredness and weakness of selective muscles), severe ulcerative colitis/toxic megacolon (inflammatory bowel disease), and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking DARITEN OD 7.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have autonomic neuropathy (a condition of nerve damage), difficulties while passing urine, severe constipation, digestive motility disorder, obstructive gastrointestinal disorder (any obstruction of the passage of intestinal or gastric contents), mild to moderate liver problems, and/or kidney problems.

DARITEN OD 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and is advised to be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

DARITEN OD 7.5MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking DARITEN OD 7.5MG TABLET are dry mouth, constipation, headache, abdominal pain, indigestion, nausea, and/or dry eyes. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

Manage symptoms of overactive bladder in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How DARITEN OD 7.5MG TABLET Works

DARITEN OD 7.5MG TABLET works by blocking certain receptors (M3 muscarinic acetylcholine receptors, responsible for bladder muscle contractions) which reduces the muscle spasms of the bladder and urinary tract thereby relaxing the bladder muscles that results in the  management of urgent, frequent, or uncontrolled urination.

introduction:
Introduction About UTWELL PRO SACHET

UTwell PRO Sachet is a female probiotic formula that helps in maintaining a healthy feminine tract microflora and management of recurrent urinary tract infections. It also helps in managing menstrual disorders and others inflammatory conditions affecting the cervix or ovaries that is caused due to urinary tract infections, chronic illness or any other stressful conditions. It also corrects hormonal imbalance and regulates menstruation in patients with polycystic ovarian disease or any other endocrine disorders.

It contains D-mannose, Hibiscus extract and Cranberry extract along with probiotics namely Lactobacillus rhamnosus and Lactobacillus reuteri. D-Mannose works by managing the bacteria from sticking to the walls of the bladder and ureters. This enables the flushing of bacteria from the urinary tract that causes infection.

Cranberry is a powerful antioxidant with antiseptic and antimicrobial properties. It improves immune functions, restores hormonal balance and manages the recurrence of urinary tract infections. Hibiscus reduces menstrual pain and regulates the release of sex hormones in females. It is also rich in vitamin C and many vital vitamins and minerals that help improve overall health and well-being.

Studies have shown that recurrent urinary tract infections and vaginal infections are linked to prolonged gut infections. Therefore, the pre/probiotics present in the medicine manages the risk of urogenital infection in women by maintaining the balance of good microorganisms in the gut.

Take UTwell PRO Sachet as recommended by your doctor. Disperse the contents of the sachet in a glass of water and drink immediately. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosages. Before taking UTwell PRO Sachet inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing disease conditions.

Introduction About CRANTRACT ORAL SUSPENSION

CRANTRACT Oral Suspension is a nutritional supplement helps in promoting urinary tract health and manages the frequency of urinary tract infection. It contains Cranberry extract, D-Mannose and Potassium Magnesium citrate as active ingredients.

Cranberry extract manages the urinary tract infection (UTI) by binding to the fimbria (tiny hair like projections) of the E. coli bacteria which is the major cause for urinary tract infection. Thereby it manages the attachment of the bacteria to the surface of urinary tract. D-mannose inhibits the attachment of the bacteria to the urinary tract by binding to the pili. Potassium Magnesium Citrate helps to provide relief from burning sensations during urination and makes the urine less acidic by raising the pH, thereby reducing irritation while urination.

Take CRANTRACT Oral Suspension as advised by your physician. Dissolve one tablespoonful (15ml) of CRANTRACT Oral Suspension in a glass of water and consume. Do not exceed the recommended daily dose. Do not take it if you are allergic to any of its components.

introduction:
Introduction About NATRISE 30MG TABLET

NATRISE 30MG TABLET contains Tolvaptan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasopressin antagonists. It is used to manage low serum sodium levels in adults who have a "syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion" (SIADH), a condition in which the kidneys retain too much water.

The symptoms of SIADH may include nausea, vomiting, headache, confusion, weakness, and feeling sick; muscle weakness, irritability, mental confusion, and tremors (involuntary shaking or movements affecting hands, legs, face, head, or vocal cords).

NATRISE 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having problems with kidney function. NATRISE 30MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes, heart disease, liver problems, and a kidney disease called autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD).

If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking NATRISE 30MG TABLET. NATRISE 30MG TABLET should not be used in children or adolescents under the age of 18. The most common side effects of taking NATRISE 30MG TABLET are thirst, dehydration, nausea, headache, and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About RENX SACHET

RENX SACHET contains Calcium Polystyrene Sulphonate which belongs to the group of medicines called Ion Exchange Resins. It is used to manage increased potassium levels in blood (hyperkalemia) due to acute and chronic renal failure that occurs after certain conditions. RENX SACHET is also used in patients with hyperkalemia associated with anuria, severe oliguria (condition marked by low urine output) and in patients requiring dialysis. Hyperkalemia is a condition of abnormally raised levels of potassium in the blood, generally characterized by symptoms such as abdominal pain, diarrhoea, chest pain, irregular heartbeat, muscle weakness, numbness, nausea, and vomiting.

Avoid taking RENX SACHET with orange juice or other fruit juices that are known to raise the blood potassium levels. It is not recommended for use if you are allergic to calcium polystyrene sulfonate and in patients with other conditions such as bowel obstruction or blocked intestine, thyroid problems and high blood calcium levels. RENX SACHET should be used with caution if you have breathing or chest problems, kidney or heart problems.

RENX SACHET should be used with caution during pregnancy and breastfeeding. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking. The common side effects associated with the use of RENX SACHET are tiredness, confusion, muscle weakness, muscle cramps, altered heart rate, nausea and vomiting. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

RENX SACHET works by releasing calcium ions in the stomach which binds to hydrogen ions and it gets exchanged with free potassium ions in the large intestine, that gets eliminated with the faeces along with the excess potassium ions thereby resulting in reduced potassium levels in the body.

name: Tolvat 30mg Tablet 4'S
introduction:
Introduction About TOLVAT 30MG TABLET

TOLVAT 30MG TABLET contains Tolvaptan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasopressin antagonists. It is used to manage low serum sodium levels in adults who have a "syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion" (SIADH), a condition in which the kidneys retain too much water.

The symptoms of SIADH may include nausea, vomiting, headache, confusion, weakness, and feeling sick; muscle weakness, irritability, mental confusion, and tremors (involuntary shaking or movements affecting hands, legs, face, head, or vocal cords).

TOLVAT 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having problems with kidney function. TOLVAT 30MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes, heart disease, liver problems, and a kidney disease called autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD).

If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking TOLVAT 30MG TABLET. TOLVAT 30MG TABLET should not be used in children or adolescents under the age of 18. The most common side effects of taking TOLVAT 30MG TABLET are thirst, dehydration, nausea, headache, and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.
uses: Manage low serum sodium levels (hyponatremia) in adults who have “syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion” (SIADH)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOLVAT 30MG TABLET
Manage low serum sodium levels (hyponatremia) in adults who have “syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion” (SIADH)
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLVAT 30MG TABLET Works

TOLVAT 30MG TABLET works by suppressing vasopressin (a hormone that helps manage the loss of water from the body by reducing urine output) leading to increased urine production and a raise in sodium concentration in blood.
usageDetails:
How to use TOLVAT 30MG TABLET

Take TOLVAT 30MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine, do not crush, or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy, weak or feeling of fainting for a short period after taking TOLVAT 30MG TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking TOLVAT 30MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol as it may increase the risk of side effects of TOLVAT 30MG TABLET.

TOLVAT 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have improper kidney function (no urine production). TOLVAT 30MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients suffering from a kidney disease called autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD). Consult your doctor before taking TOLVAT 30MG TABLET.
TOLVAT 30MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking TOLVAT 30MG TABLET.
TOLVAT 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Tolvaptan or Benzazepine derivatives (Ex. benazepril, conivaptan, fenoldopam mesylate or mirtazapine).
TOLVAT 30MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having congestive heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking TOLVAT 30MG TABLET.

Others

TOLVAT 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Hypernatremia (a condition which increases the salt in blood)
Any condition which is associated with a very low blood volume
Feeling of not realising when you are thirsty

Before taking TOLVAT 30MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Cannot drink enough water or in fluid restricted diet
Have difficulties in urination or have an enlarged prostate
Diabetes

TOLVAT 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking TOLVAT 30MG TABLET.

Use in geriatrics:

TOLVAT 30MG TABLET is used with caution in patients above 65 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking TOLVAT 30MG TABLET.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking TOLVAT 30MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Ketoconazole (a medicine used against fungal infections)
Macrolide antibiotics such as erythromycin, azithromycin, and clarithromycin (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Diltiazem (a medicine used in the management of high blood pressure and chest pain)
Medicines that increase the salt in your blood or which contain large amounts of salt (Ex. Sodium bicarbonate, sodium chloride, diuretics like furosemide, and bumetanide)
Barbiturates like phenobarbital, and pentobarbital (medicines used to manage epilepsy/seizures and some sleep disorders)
Rifampicin (a medicine used against tuberculosis)
Digoxin (medicine used in the management of irregular heartbeat and heart failure)
Desmopressin (a medicine used to increase blood clotting factors)

B. Drug–Food interactions:

Do not eat grapefruit or drink grapefruit juice while you are taking this medicine as it can increase the risk of side effects of this medicine. Consult your doctor before taking TOLVAT 30MG TABLET.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of TOLVAT 30MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are a rise in serum sodium concentration, polyuria, thirst, and dehydration/hypovolemia (profuse and prolonged aquaresis).

introduction:
Introduction About ACUTROL C 400MG TABLET

ACUTROL C 400MG TABLET contains Sevelamer, which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphate Binding Agents. It is used to control the serum phosphorous levels in patients with long-term kidney disease who are on dialysis. Renal failure is the most common cause of high phosphorous levels, as there is reduced filtration of inorganic phosphate, increasing its serum levels.

During management, your doctor might ask you to take certain tests to avoid any untoward side effects. Follow the diet as advised by your doctor.

ACUTROL C 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with low levels of phosphorus in the blood or bowel obstruction. ACUTROL C 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have trouble swallowing, motility problems in the stomach and bowel, and in those who have undergone major bowel surgery.

ACUTROL C 400MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if your doctor finds it clearly necessary. It is unknown whether ACUTROL C 400MG TABLET is excreted in breast milk and may affect your baby, so consult your doctor before taking it during breastfeeding.  ACUTROL C 400MG TABLET is not intended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking ACUTROL C 400MG TABLET are constipation, vomiting, upper abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, indigestion, flatulence (gas), etc. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.

How ACUTROL C 400MG TABLET Works

Take ACUTROL C 400MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide an appropriate dose and duration of ACUTROL C 400MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking ACUTROL C 400MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About POTRATE M ORAL SOLUTION

POTRATE M ORAL SOLUTION is a combination of Potassium citrate and Magnesium citrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Urinary alkalizers and Saline laxatives respectively. It is used in the management of renal tubular acidosis with calcium stones and kidney stones (hypocitraturic calcium oxalate nephrolithiasis and uric acid lithiasis with or without calcium stones).

Renal tubular acidosis is a condition in which the kidneys do not remove acids from the blood into the urine as they usually should. Before taking POTRATE M ORAL SOLUTION, your doctor might want you to take certain blood tests and ECG to understand your existing condition.

POTRATE M ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients with hyperkalemia (high potassium levels in the blood), gastrointestinal disease, peptic ulcer disease, urinary tract infection and kidney disease.

POTRATE M ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is clearly advised by the doctor. Safety and effectiveness of POTRATE M ORAL SOLUTION in children has not been established yet. The most common side effects of taking POTRATE M ORAL SOLUTION are abdominal discomfort, nausea, vomiting and diarrhea.
uses: Renal tubular acidosis (RTA) with calcium stones
Hypocitraturic calcium oxalate nephrolithiasis
Uric acid lithiasis (with or without calcium stones)
usesDetails:

Manages,

mechanismOfAction:
How POTRATE M ORAL SOLUTION Works

POTRATE M ORAL SOLUTION works by reducing the kidney stone formation. Potassium citrate and magnesium citrate, causes the metabolism of absorbed citrate producing an alkaline load. In addition to raising urinary pH and citrate, this also increases urinary potassium and magnesium. In certain patients, potassium citrate causes a transient reduction in urinary calcium. These changes produce urine that is less helpful to the crystallization of stone-forming salts.
usageDetails:

Take POTRATE M ORAL SOLUTION as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Use a measuring cup or spoon to properly measure a dose. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Severe abdominal pain, vomiting or gastrointestinal bleeding

introduction:
Introduction About SEVETAG 400MG TABLET

SEVETAG 400MG TABLET contains Sevelamer, which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphate Binding Agents. It is used to control the serum phosphorous levels in patients with long-term kidney disease who are on dialysis. Renal failure is the most common cause of high phosphorous levels, as there is reduced filtration of inorganic phosphate, increasing its serum levels.

During management, your doctor might ask you to take certain tests to avoid any untoward side effects. Follow the diet as advised by your doctor.

SEVETAG 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with low levels of phosphorus in the blood or bowel obstruction. SEVETAG 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have trouble swallowing, motility problems in the stomach and bowel, and in those who have undergone major bowel surgery.

SEVETAG 400MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if your doctor finds it clearly necessary. It is unknown whether SEVETAG 400MG TABLET is excreted in breast milk and may affect your baby, so consult your doctor before taking it during breastfeeding.  SEVETAG 400MG TABLET is not intended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking SEVETAG 400MG TABLET are constipation, vomiting, upper abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, indigestion, flatulence (gas), etc. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How SEVETAG 400MG TABLET Works

SEVETAG 400MG TABLET is a chelating agent that helps in reducing the phosphorus levels in the blood by binding to the phosphate that enters the body with food and managing its absorption.

Your doctor will decide an appropriate dose and duration of SEVETAG 400MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking SEVETAG 400MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About TOLVARISE 15 TABLET

TOLVARISE 15 TABLET contains Tolvaptan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasopressin antagonists. It is used to manage low serum sodium levels in adults who have a "syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion" (SIADH), a condition in which the kidneys retain too much water.

The symptoms of SIADH may include nausea, vomiting, headache, confusion, weakness, and feeling sick; muscle weakness, irritability, mental confusion, and tremors (involuntary shaking or movements affecting hands, legs, face, head, or vocal cords).

TOLVARISE 15 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having problems with kidney function. TOLVARISE 15 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes, heart disease, liver problems, and a kidney disease called autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD).

If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking TOLVARISE 15 TABLET. TOLVARISE 15 TABLET should not be used in children or adolescents under the age of 18. The most common side effects of taking TOLVARISE 15 TABLET are thirst, dehydration, nausea, headache, and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.
uses: Manage low serum sodium levels (hyponatremia) in adults who have “syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion” (SIADH)

How TOLVARISE 15 TABLET Works

TOLVARISE 15 TABLET works by suppressing vasopressin (a hormone that helps manage the loss of water from the body by reducing urine output) leading to increased urine production and a raise in sodium concentration in blood.

introduction:
Introduction About SIVEL 400 TABLET

SIVEL 400 TABLET contains Sevelamer, which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphate Binding Agents. It is used to control the serum phosphorous levels in patients with long-term kidney disease who are on dialysis. Renal failure is the most common cause of high phosphorous levels, as there is reduced filtration of inorganic phosphate, increasing its serum levels.

During management, your doctor might ask you to take certain tests to avoid any untoward side effects. Follow the diet as advised by your doctor.

SIVEL 400 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with low levels of phosphorus in the blood or bowel obstruction. SIVEL 400 TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have trouble swallowing, motility problems in the stomach and bowel, and in those who have undergone major bowel surgery.

SIVEL 400 TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if your doctor finds it clearly necessary. It is unknown whether SIVEL 400 TABLET is excreted in breast milk and may affect your baby, so consult your doctor before taking it during breastfeeding.  SIVEL 400 TABLET is not intended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking SIVEL 400 TABLET are constipation, vomiting, upper abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, indigestion, flatulence (gas), etc. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.
uses: Used to control the serum phosphorous levels in patients with chronic kidney disease who are on dialysis
usesDetails:

Used to control the serum phosphorous levels in patients with chronic kidney disease who are on dialysis
mechanismOfAction:
How SIVEL 400 TABLET Works

SIVEL 400 TABLET is a chelating agent that helps in reducing the phosphorus levels in the blood by binding to the phosphate that enters the body with food and managing its absorption.
usageDetails:
How to use SIVEL 400 TABLET

Take SIVEL 400 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide an appropriate dose and duration of SIVEL 400 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking SIVEL 400 TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About NOCULI SOLUTION

NOCULI SOLUTION is a combination of Potassium citrate and Magnesium citrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Urinary alkalizers and Saline laxatives respectively. It is used in the management of renal tubular acidosis with calcium stones and kidney stones (hypocitraturic calcium oxalate nephrolithiasis and uric acid lithiasis with or without calcium stones).

Renal tubular acidosis is a condition in which the kidneys do not remove acids from the blood into the urine as they usually should. Before taking NOCULI SOLUTION, your doctor might want you to take certain blood tests and ECG to understand your existing condition.

NOCULI SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients with hyperkalemia (high potassium levels in the blood), gastrointestinal disease, peptic ulcer disease, urinary tract infection and kidney disease.

NOCULI SOLUTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is clearly advised by the doctor. Safety and effectiveness of NOCULI SOLUTION in children has not been established yet. The most common side effects of taking NOCULI SOLUTION are abdominal discomfort, nausea, vomiting and diarrhea.
uses: Renal tubular acidosis (RTA) with calcium stones

mechanismOfAction:
How NOCULI SOLUTION Works

NOCULI SOLUTION works by reducing the kidney stone formation. Potassium citrate and magnesium citrate, causes the metabolism of absorbed citrate producing an alkaline load. In addition to raising urinary pH and citrate, this also increases urinary potassium and magnesium. In certain patients, potassium citrate causes a transient reduction in urinary calcium. These changes produce urine that is less helpful to the crystallization of stone-forming salts.

introduction:
Introduction About DERITAS 7.5MG TABLET

DERITAS 7.5MG TABLET contains Darifenacin which belongs to a group of medicines called Antimuscarinics. DERITAS 7.5MG TABLET is used in adults to manage symptoms of overactive bladder conditions such as a sudden urge to rush to the toilet, needing to go to the toilet frequently and/or not getting to the toilet in time and wetting yourself (urge incontinence).

DERITAS 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Darifenacin. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from urinary retention (inability to empty your bladder), gastric retention, uncontrolled narrow-angle glaucoma (high pressure in the eyes),  that is not being adequately manageed), myasthenia gravis (disease characterized by unusual tiredness and weakness of selective muscles), severe ulcerative colitis/toxic megacolon (inflammatory bowel disease), and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking DERITAS 7.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have autonomic neuropathy (a condition of nerve damage), difficulties while passing urine, severe constipation, digestive motility disorder, obstructive gastrointestinal disorder (any obstruction of the passage of intestinal or gastric contents), mild to moderate liver problems, and/or kidney problems.

DERITAS 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and is advised to be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

DERITAS 7.5MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking DERITAS 7.5MG TABLET are dry mouth, constipation, headache, abdominal pain, indigestion, nausea, and/or dry eyes. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
uses: Manage symptoms of overactive bladder in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of DERITAS 7.5MG TABLET
Manage symptoms of overactive bladder in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How DERITAS 7.5MG TABLET Works

DERITAS 7.5MG TABLET works by blocking certain receptors (M3 muscarinic acetylcholine receptors, responsible for bladder muscle contractions) which reduces the muscle spasms of the bladder and urinary tract thereby relaxing the bladder muscles that results in the  management of urgent, frequent, or uncontrolled urination.

introduction:
Introduction About POTZEST ORAL SOLUTION

POTZEST Oral Solution is an alkalizer used in the management of kidney stones, renal tubular acidosis, burning micturition, and dysuria. It contains potassium citrate, magnesium citrate, and vitamin B6 as active ingredients.

Potassium citrate and magnesium citrate work by increasing the pH of the urine, decreasing the formation of kidney stones, and helping reduce the burning sensation during urination. Vitamin B6 and magnesium help manage kidney stone formation.

Always take POTZEST Oral Solution as advised by your doctor. Shake well before use. Always dilute with a glass of water before taking. Take 10 ml twice daily or as directed by your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About VESIGARD 7.5MG TABLET

VESIGARD 7.5MG TABLET contains Darifenacin which belongs to a group of medicines called Antimuscarinics. VESIGARD 7.5MG TABLET is used in adults to manage symptoms of overactive bladder conditions such as a sudden urge to rush to the toilet, needing to go to the toilet frequently and/or not getting to the toilet in time and wetting yourself (urge incontinence).

VESIGARD 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Darifenacin. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from urinary retention (inability to empty your bladder), gastric retention, uncontrolled narrow-angle glaucoma (high pressure in the eyes),  that is not being adequately manageed), myasthenia gravis (disease characterized by unusual tiredness and weakness of selective muscles), severe ulcerative colitis/toxic megacolon (inflammatory bowel disease), and/or severe liver disease.

Before taking VESIGARD 7.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have autonomic neuropathy (a condition of nerve damage), difficulties while passing urine, severe constipation, digestive motility disorder, obstructive gastrointestinal disorder (any obstruction of the passage of intestinal or gastric contents), mild to moderate liver problems, and/or kidney problems.

VESIGARD 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and is advised to be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

VESIGARD 7.5MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking VESIGARD 7.5MG TABLET are dry mouth, constipation, headache, abdominal pain, indigestion, nausea, and/or dry eyes. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
uses: Manage symptoms of overactive bladder in adults

mechanismOfAction:
How VESIGARD 7.5MG TABLET Works

VESIGARD 7.5MG TABLET works by blocking certain receptors (M3 muscarinic acetylcholine receptors, responsible for bladder muscle contractions) which reduces the muscle spasms of the bladder and urinary tract thereby relaxing the bladder muscles that results in the  management of urgent, frequent, or uncontrolled urination.

introduction:
Introduction About ZITOTEC 200MCG TABLET

ZITOTEC 200MCG TABLET contains Misoprostol which belongs to the group of medicines called Prostaglandin Analogs. It is used to manage peptic ulcer, predominantly caused due to excessive NSAID use (such as diclofenac, naproxen).

It can also be used for cervical ripening (dilation) prior to certain uterine procedures and for inducing labour pain. It is also used in combination with mifepristone (an abortion pill) to induce abortion during the early stages of pregnancy (first trimester) and can manage excessive blood loss after childbirth.

Take ZITOTEC 200MCG TABLET with meals to avoid stomach upset. Avoid taking antacids (containing magnesium) along with this medicine as it may increase the risk of severe stomach problems.

Before taking ZITOTEC 200MCG TABLET inform your doctor if you previously delivered your baby via caesarean section. You must also inform your doctor if you have any heart problems, high or low blood pressure, inflammatory bowel diseases or problems in blood vessels as a precaution.

Pregnant women should not get themselves exposed to this medicine as it may cause abortion or serious birth defects in the growing baby. It is also not suitable for use in breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant while taking this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking ZITOTEC 200MCG TABLET are skin rashes, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, stomach pain, constipation, bloating, indigestion, birth defects (if accidentally exposed during pregnancy), vaginal bleeding (even after menopause) and severe uterine cramps. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How ZITOTEC 200MCG TABLET Works

ZITOTEC 200MCG TABLET reduces excessive stomach acid secretion caused due to prolonged NSAIDs use. This action heals the existing ulcers, manages new ulcers formation and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity and heartburn).

It also stimulates the contraction of uterine muscles which helps in initiating labour pain, reducing postpartum bleeding and for inducing abortion during the early stages of pregnancy. It also degrades the cells and tissues around the cervix, which helps in cervical ripening (softening) prior to uterine procedures.

introduction:
Introduction About SODIUM BICARBONATE (LIFECARE) 7.5% INJECTION

SODIUM BICARBONATE (LIFECARE) 7.5% INJECTION contains Sodium Bicarbonate, which belongs to the group of medicines called alkalinizing agents. It is used to manage metabolic acidosis (the correction of the body's acid-alkaline balance), which can occur in conditions such as severe kidney disease, uncontrolled diabetes, circulatory insufficiency due to shock or severe dehydration, extracorporeal blood circulation, cardiac arrest, and drug overdoses such as barbiturates (where dissociation of the barbiturate-protein complex is desired), salicylate poisoning, methyl alcohol poisoning, and haemolytic reactions.

It is also used in severe diarrhea, which is often accompanied by a significant loss of bicarbonate. Additionally, it will be used to manage patients who have overused tricyclic antidepressants. It will be used only after the other resuscitation methods.

SODIUM BICARBONATE (LIFECARE) 7.5% INJECTION is not recommended in patients with kidney failure or kidney stones, high blood pressure, heart failure, shallow or slow breathing than usual (hypoventilation), any blood abnormalities such as high sodium levels, low levels of calcium, potassium, or chloride, or if your blood is less acidic than usual, fluid retention. SODIUM BICARBONATE (LIFECARE) 7.5% INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

SODIUM BICARBONATE (LIFECARE) 7.5% INJECTION should be given to a pregnant woman only if clearly needed. Contact your doctor before receiving SODIUM BICARBONATE (LIFECARE) 7.5% INJECTION should be used with caution in neonates and children under 2 years of age. Serious side effects of receiving SODIUM BICARBONATE (LIFECARE) 7.5% INJECTION are pain, burning, or swelling at the site of the injection, extreme irritability, muscle spasms or cramps, breathing difficulties, low potassium levels, which can cause twitching and muscle weakness, etc. Consult your doctor if your symptoms get worse or persist.

SODIUM BICARBONATE (LIFECARE) 7.5% INJECTION is a systemic alkalizer, which increases plasma bicarbonate, buffers the excess hydrogen ion concentration, and raises blood pH, thereby reversing the clinical effects of acidosis.

SODIUM BICARBONATE (LIFECARE) 7.5% INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will fix the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and medical condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PREGCLEAR 200MG TABLET

PREGCLEAR 200MG TABLET contains Misoprostol which belongs to the group of medicines called Prostaglandin Analogs. It is used to manage peptic ulcer, predominantly caused due to excessive NSAID use (such as diclofenac, naproxen).

It can also be used for cervical ripening (dilation) prior to certain uterine procedures and for inducing labour pain. It is also used in combination with mifepristone (an abortion pill) to induce abortion during the early stages of pregnancy (first trimester) and can manage excessive blood loss after childbirth.

Take PREGCLEAR 200MG TABLET with meals to avoid stomach upset. Avoid taking antacids (containing magnesium) along with this medicine as it may increase the risk of severe stomach problems.

Before taking PREGCLEAR 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you previously delivered your baby via caesarean section. You must also inform your doctor if you have any heart problems, high or low blood pressure, inflammatory bowel diseases or problems in blood vessels as a precaution.

Pregnant women should not get themselves exposed to this medicine as it may cause abortion or serious birth defects in the growing baby. It is also not suitable for use in breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant while taking this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking PREGCLEAR 200MG TABLET are skin rashes, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, stomach pain, constipation, bloating, indigestion, birth defects (if accidentally exposed during pregnancy), vaginal bleeding (even after menopause) and severe uterine cramps. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How PREGCLEAR 200MG TABLET Works

PREGCLEAR 200MG TABLET reduces excessive stomach acid secretion caused due to prolonged NSAIDs use. This action heals the existing ulcers, manages new ulcers formation and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity and heartburn).

It also stimulates the contraction of uterine muscles which helps in initiating labour pain, reducing postpartum bleeding and for inducing abortion during the early stages of pregnancy. It also degrades the cells and tissues around the cervix, which helps in cervical ripening (softening) prior to uterine procedures.
usageDetails:
How to use PREGCLEAR 200MG TABLET

Take PREGCLEAR 200MG TABLET with meals to avoid stomach upset. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: TOLVARISE 30 Tablet 4's
introduction:
Introduction About TOLVARISE 30 TABLET

TOLVARISE 30 TABLET contains Tolvaptan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasopressin antagonists. It is used to manage low serum sodium levels in adults who have a "syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion" (SIADH), a condition in which the kidneys retain too much water.

The symptoms of SIADH may include nausea, vomiting, headache, confusion, weakness, and feeling sick; muscle weakness, irritability, mental confusion, and tremors (involuntary shaking or movements affecting hands, legs, face, head, or vocal cords).

TOLVARISE 30 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having problems with kidney function. TOLVARISE 30 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes, heart disease, liver problems, and a kidney disease called autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD).

If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking TOLVARISE 30 TABLET. TOLVARISE 30 TABLET should not be used in children or adolescents under the age of 18. The most common side effects of taking TOLVARISE 30 TABLET are thirst, dehydration, nausea, headache, and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.
uses: Manage low serum sodium levels (hyponatremia) in adults who have “syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion” (SIADH)

TOLVARISE 30 TABLET works by suppressing vasopressin (a hormone that helps manage the loss of water from the body by reducing urine output) leading to increased urine production and a raise in sodium concentration in blood.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking TOLVARISE 30 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Ketoconazole (a medicine used against fungal infections)
Macrolide antibiotics such as erythromycin, azithromycin, and clarithromycin (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Diltiazem (a medicine used in the management of high blood pressure and chest pain)
Medicines that increase the salt in your blood or which contain large amounts of salt (Ex. Sodium bicarbonate, sodium chloride, diuretics like furosemide, and bumetanide)
Barbiturates like phenobarbital, and pentobarbital (medicines used to manage epilepsy/seizures and some sleep disorders)
Rifampicin (a medicine used against tuberculosis)
Digoxin (medicine used in the management of irregular heartbeat and heart failure)
Desmopressin (a medicine used to increase blood clotting factors)

B. Drug–Food interactions:

Do not eat grapefruit or drink grapefruit juice while you are taking this medicine as it can increase the risk of side effects of this medicine. Consult your doctor before taking TOLVARISE 30 TABLET.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of TOLVARISE 30 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are a rise in serum sodium concentration, polyuria, thirst, and dehydration/hypovolemia (profuse and prolonged aquaresis).

name: LACTOGUT UG Capsule 10's
introduction:
Introduction About LACTOGUT UG CAPSULE

Lactogut UG Capsule is a pre-/pro-biotic supplement specifically designed to maintain good urogenital health in women. It also balances vaginal pH and manages the risk of vaginal yeast infections and urinary tract infections. It contains a proprietary probiotic blend of good bacteria that helps to improve urogenital health.

Studies have shown that, recurrent urinary tract infections and vaginal infections are linked to prolonged gut infections. Therefore, the pre/probiotics present in the medicine manages the risk of urogenital infection in women by maintaining the balance of good microorganisms in the gut.

Additionally, they can also manage the growth of harmful microbes in the gut and improves vaginal immunity. Take Lactogut UG Capsule as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Before taking Lactogut UG Capsule inform your doctor if you have any inflammatory bowel diseases or gut problems as a precaution. You must also consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution. Do not take Lactogut UG Capsule if you are allergic to any of its ingredients.

name: SIVEL 800 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About SIVEL 800 TABLET

SIVEL 800 TABLET contains Sevelamer, which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphate Binding Agents. It is used to control the serum phosphorous levels in patients with long-term kidney disease who are on dialysis. Renal failure is the most common cause of high phosphorous levels, as there is reduced filtration of inorganic phosphate, increasing its serum levels.

During management, your doctor might ask you to take certain tests to avoid any untoward side effects. Follow the diet as advised by your doctor.

SIVEL 800 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with low levels of phosphorus in the blood or bowel obstruction. SIVEL 800 TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have trouble swallowing, motility problems in the stomach and bowel, and in those who have undergone major bowel surgery.

SIVEL 800 TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if your doctor finds it clearly necessary. It is unknown whether SIVEL 800 TABLET is excreted in breast milk and may affect your baby, so consult your doctor before taking it during breastfeeding.  SIVEL 800 TABLET is not intended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking SIVEL 800 TABLET are constipation, vomiting, upper abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, indigestion, flatulence (gas), etc. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.

How SIVEL 800 TABLET Works

usageDetails:
How to use SIVEL 800 TABLET

Take SIVEL 800 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide an appropriate dose and duration of SIVEL 800 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking SIVEL 800 TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

name: MICTUEASE 25mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About MICTUEASE 25MG TABLET

MICTUEASE 25MG TABLET is used in the management of urinary retention (inability to empty the bladder) following an operation or after giving birth or other health problems (such as brain, spinal, or nerve problems) and is also used to manage reflux esophagitis (inflammation of the esophagus due to backflow of stomach contents into the esophagus).

MICTUEASE 25MG TABLET contains bethanechol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Cholinergic agents. It works by making the contraction of urinary bladder muscles sufficiently strong to initiate urination and empty the bladder. It also stimulates motility, increases the tone of the stomach, and often restores impaired rhythmic peristalsis (wave-like muscle contractions that move food through the digestive tract).

MICTUEASE 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with gut or heart problems, asthma, fits, parkinsonism, or if you have had recent surgery on your stomach. MICTUEASE 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients taking certain medicines for heart problems, as a critical fall in blood pressure may occur.

MICTUEASE 25MG TABLET should be used with caution by pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. It is not recommended for use in elderly patients (above 70 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking MICTUEASE 25MG TABLET are diarrhea, skin flushing, increased salivation and sweating, decreased body temperature (hypothermia), etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Do not take MICTUEASE 25MG TABLET if you are allergic to Bethanechol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

name: Tvaptan 15mg Tablet 4'S
introduction:
Introduction About TVAPTAN 15MG TABLET

TVAPTAN 15MG TABLET contains Tolvaptan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasopressin antagonists. It is used to manage low serum sodium levels in adults who have a "syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion" (SIADH), a condition in which the kidneys retain too much water.

The symptoms of SIADH may include nausea, vomiting, headache, confusion, weakness, and feeling sick; muscle weakness, irritability, mental confusion, and tremors (involuntary shaking or movements affecting hands, legs, face, head, or vocal cords).

TVAPTAN 15MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having problems with kidney function. TVAPTAN 15MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes, heart disease, liver problems, and a kidney disease called autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD).

If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking TVAPTAN 15MG TABLET. TVAPTAN 15MG TABLET should not be used in children or adolescents under the age of 18. The most common side effects of taking TVAPTAN 15MG TABLET are thirst, dehydration, nausea, headache, and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

TVAPTAN 15MG TABLET works by suppressing vasopressin (a hormone that helps manage the loss of water from the body by reducing urine output) leading to increased urine production and a raise in sodium concentration in blood.

TVAPTAN 15MG TABLET is used with caution in patients above 65 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking TVAPTAN 15MG TABLET.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking TVAPTAN 15MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Ketoconazole (a medicine used against fungal infections)
Macrolide antibiotics such as erythromycin, azithromycin, and clarithromycin (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Diltiazem (a medicine used in the management of high blood pressure and chest pain)
Medicines that increase the salt in your blood or which contain large amounts of salt (Ex. Sodium bicarbonate, sodium chloride, diuretics like furosemide, and bumetanide)
Barbiturates like phenobarbital, and pentobarbital (medicines used to manage epilepsy/seizures and some sleep disorders)
Rifampicin (a medicine used against tuberculosis)
Digoxin (medicine used in the management of irregular heartbeat and heart failure)
Desmopressin (a medicine used to increase blood clotting factors)

B. Drug–Food interactions:

Do not eat grapefruit or drink grapefruit juice while you are taking this medicine as it can increase the risk of side effects of this medicine. Consult your doctor before taking TVAPTAN 15MG TABLET.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of TVAPTAN 15MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are a rise in serum sodium concentration, polyuria, thirst, and dehydration/hypovolemia (profuse and prolonged aquaresis).

name: Sevapik 400mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About SEVAPIK 400MG TABLET

SEVAPIK 400MG TABLET contains Sevelamer, which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphate Binding Agents. It is used to control the serum phosphorous levels in patients with long-term kidney disease who are on dialysis. Renal failure is the most common cause of high phosphorous levels, as there is reduced filtration of inorganic phosphate, increasing its serum levels.

During management, your doctor might ask you to take certain tests to avoid any untoward side effects. Follow the diet as advised by your doctor.

SEVAPIK 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with low levels of phosphorus in the blood or bowel obstruction. SEVAPIK 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have trouble swallowing, motility problems in the stomach and bowel, and in those who have undergone major bowel surgery.

SEVAPIK 400MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if your doctor finds it clearly necessary. It is unknown whether SEVAPIK 400MG TABLET is excreted in breast milk and may affect your baby, so consult your doctor before taking it during breastfeeding.  SEVAPIK 400MG TABLET is not intended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking SEVAPIK 400MG TABLET are constipation, vomiting, upper abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, indigestion, flatulence (gas), etc. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.

How SEVAPIK 400MG TABLET Works

SEVAPIK 400MG TABLET is a chelating agent that helps in reducing the phosphorus levels in the blood by binding to the phosphate that enters the body with food and managing its absorption.

Take SEVAPIK 400MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide an appropriate dose and duration of SEVAPIK 400MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking SEVAPIK 400MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

name: Citalift Sugar Free Raspberry Flavour Oral Solution 200ml
introduction:
Introduction About CITALIFT ORAL SOLUTION

CITALIFT ORAL SOLUTION is a combination of Potassium citrate and Magnesium citrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Urinary alkalizers and Saline laxatives respectively. It is used in the management of renal tubular acidosis with calcium stones and kidney stones (hypocitraturic calcium oxalate nephrolithiasis and uric acid lithiasis with or without calcium stones).

Renal tubular acidosis is a condition in which the kidneys do not remove acids from the blood into the urine as they usually should. Before taking CITALIFT ORAL SOLUTION, your doctor might want you to take certain blood tests and ECG to understand your existing condition.

CITALIFT ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients with hyperkalemia (high potassium levels in the blood), gastrointestinal disease, peptic ulcer disease, urinary tract infection and kidney disease.

CITALIFT ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is clearly advised by the doctor. Safety and effectiveness of CITALIFT ORAL SOLUTION in children has not been established yet. The most common side effects of taking CITALIFT ORAL SOLUTION are abdominal discomfort, nausea, vomiting and diarrhea.
uses: Renal tubular acidosis (RTA) with calcium stones

Uric acid lithiasis (with or without calcium stones)

mechanismOfAction:
How CITALIFT ORAL SOLUTION Works

CITALIFT ORAL SOLUTION works by reducing the kidney stone formation. Potassium citrate and magnesium citrate, causes the metabolism of absorbed citrate producing an alkaline load. In addition to raising urinary pH and citrate, this also increases urinary potassium and magnesium. In certain patients, potassium citrate causes a transient reduction in urinary calcium. These changes produce urine that is less helpful to the crystallization of stone-forming salts.

Take CITALIFT ORAL SOLUTION as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Use a measuring cup or spoon to properly measure a dose. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Severe abdominal pain, vomiting or gastrointestinal bleeding

warnings.details: CITALIFT ORAL SOLUTION should be used in pregnant woman only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking it.
CITALIFT ORAL SOLUTION should be used in breast-feeding woman only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking it.
CITALIFT ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients with renal insufficiency. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take CITALIFT ORAL SOLUTION if you are allergic to potassium citrate or magnesium citrate.
CITALIFT ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe myocardial damage or heart failure because it impairs the excretion of potassium. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Safety and effectiveness of CITALIFT ORAL SOLUTION have not been established yet in children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Others

CITALIFT ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have hyperkalemia (increased level of potassium in the blood) or pre-disposing factor of hyperkalemia (such as uncontrolled diabetes mellitus, acute dehydration, strenuous physical exercise in unconditioned individuals, adrenal insufficiency, extensive tissue breakdown)
Have cause for arrest or delay in passage through the gastrointestinal tract (such as those suffering from delayed gastric emptying, esophageal compression, intestinal obstruction or stricture)
Have peptic ulcer disease
Have urinary tract infection
